archetypeEssence.en: A tangible seed of prosperity placed directly into your open hands—real ground waiting to be cultivated.
archetypeEssence.zh: 一枚落入掌心的现实丰盛种子——触手可及的沃土正等待你亲手耕耘。

en: Luminous hand emerging from a cloud offering a single embossed golden pentacle
Walled lush garden blooming with white lilies and verdant foliage below
Winding stone path leading through a floral archway toward distant mountain peaks
Clear bright sky signaling material blessing and grounded potential
zh: 自云端伸出、托举一枚浮雕古金星币的明亮之手
下方盛开白百合与繁茂绿意的围墙花园
穿过鲜花拱门、通往远山峰峦的蜿蜒石径
澄明晴朗的天光，象征落地可期的现实福泽

en: Radiant Belle Epoque hand emerging from moonlit ivory-gold clouds holding exactly one large embossed antique-gold pentacle coin
Lush nocturnal-and-dawn terraced garden overflowing with luminous white lilies and emerald-verdigris foliage
Graceful rose-and-ivy stone archway framing a winding golden-lit path toward misty indigo mountain peaks
Sunlit ivory rim-light and molten gold specular gleam illuminating the single pentacle against deep midnight-indigo sky
zh: 自月白金云中探出、稳稳托举一枚硕大浮雕古金星币的优雅之手
下方盛放月白百合与祖母绿繁叶的晨曦花园
爬满藤蔓与玫瑰的石拱门，框出通往靛蓝远山的暖金小径
晨光象牙白与熔金高光在深邃午夜蓝天幕下点亮这枚唯一星币

core.en: Ace of Pentacles marks a concrete, grounded opening: a real offer, resource, skill, or healthy habit you can actually build on. It is not a finished fortune yet, but a fertile seed that rewards steady care.
core.zh: 星币王牌标志一个扎实可落地的开端：一份真实的机会、资源、技能或健康习惯正递到你面前。它还不是现成的丰收，却是一颗只要持续照料就能长出硕果的良种。

message.en: Take the practical offer seriously—plant it in real soil with a concrete budget, schedule, or first deliverable.
message.zh: 认真接住眼前这份务实的契机——用明确预算、日程或首个交付物把它真正种进土里。

foundation.en: A tangible grant, job offer, material windfall, or grounded commitment laid the fertile starting ground here.
foundation.zh: 一份切实的资助、工作机会、一笔意外进账或踏实承诺，为眼下铺好了肥沃的起点。

present.en: A real-world doorway is open right now; focus on what is measurable and sustainable rather than abstract speculation.
present.zh: 一扇通往现实成果的门正敞开着；把注意力放在可衡量、可持续的实事上，而非空想。

challenge.en: The risk here is treating a promising seed as if it were already harvested; neglect or impatience can waste good ground.
challenge.zh: 眼下的风险，是把刚发芽的良种当成已经到手的收成；疏忽或急躁都会浪费一块好地。

resource.en: You have genuine material leverage—funding, health, a marketable craft, or a reliable ally—ready to be put to work.
resource.zh: 你手里握着实打实的现实资本——资金、体力、硬技能或可靠支持——正待投入运作。

action.en: Say yes to one concrete opportunity, set up the basic infrastructure, and make the first physical deposit of time or money.
action.zh: 接下那个最实在的机会，搭好基础架构，投入第一笔实实在在的时间或资金。

outcome.en: If you keep tending it, this tends to root into a durable, rewarding chapter: tangible stability, income, or physical wellbeing that grows stronger over time.
outcome.zh: 只要持续照料，这件事多半能扎下根来，长成一段稳健丰厚的新周期——看得见的安稳、收入或身体状态，有望随时间越养越厚。

advice.en: Honor the small beginnings: tend the garden path step by step instead of waiting for overnight riches.
advice.zh: 敬重微小的起点：顺着花园石径一步步打理，别指望一夜暴富。

hidden.en: Check whether a practical opening is already sitting in plain sight—an unanswered offer, an underused skill, or savings you have not counted as a real starting point.
hidden.zh: 留意一下，是否有个务实的机会其实早已摆在眼前——一份还没回复的邀约、一项没用起来的本事，或一笔你从没当成起步资本的积蓄。

self.en: You come to this with open hands and a practical streak: ready to start small, do the groundwork, and treat a modest beginning as something worth tending.
self.zh: 你是摊开双手、带着务实劲儿来到这件事面前的：愿意从小处起步，把基础功做足，也肯把一个不起眼的开头当回事来照料。

other.en: What the other party is putting forward looks concrete rather than talk—a real proposal, resource, or commitment—and they seem willing to put it on the table.
other.zh: 对方拿出的看起来是实在的东西，而不只是口头表态——一份具体的提议、资源或承诺，并且似乎愿意把它摆到台面上来。

external.en: Conditions around you favor starting something tangible: the timing is workable, the ground is fertile, and practical support or funding is within reach.
external.zh: 外部环境适合开启一件实在的事：时机合宜，土壤肥沃，现实层面的支持或资金也够得着。

hopes_fears.en: You hope this is finally the solid start you can build a stable life on, yet fear it is too small to matter or that you will fumble the one good chance in your hands.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着这就是那个能让日子稳下来的扎实开端，却又怕它太小不成气候，或怕自己把手里难得的好机会弄砸。

general.en: A fertile, practical beginning is in your hands. Ground your vision in concrete steps so promising potential becomes lasting reality.
general.zh: 一个肥沃务实的开端正落在你掌心。把构想落到具体步骤上，好苗头才能长成经得起考验的现实成果。

love.en: In love, Ace of Pentacles favors steady, dependable affection—a relationship with real-world footing, shared home-building, or showing care through consistent presence rather than empty grand gestures.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币王牌青睐踏实可靠的亲密——有现实根基的关系、共同筑巢的意愿，或用日常兑现而非空口承诺去表达爱意。

career.en: At work, this signals a strong new role, client, grant, or business seed with real upside. Negotiate clear terms and invest early in quality foundations.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，它预示一份极具潜力的岗位、客户、资金或事业良种。谈清条款，尽早把基础打牢。

health.en: For wellbeing, a fresh physical routine—better sleep, nourishing food, or a realistic training plan—will take root quickly if you start gently and stay consistent.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，一套全新的养护节奏（规律睡眠、踏实饮食或循序渐进的锻炼）只要温和起步并坚持，很快就能见效。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, the sacred lives inside ordinary matter: treating your body, home, and daily craft with reverence is the practice itself.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，神圣就在日常烟火与物质之中：怀着敬意照料身体、居所与手头工作，本身就是最好的修行。

core.en: Ace of Pentacles reversed points to a missed window, shaky financial footing, or a good idea lacking practical planning before launch.
core.zh: 星币王牌逆位指向错失窗口、现实基础不牢，或好点子在落地前缺少扎实规划。

blocked.en: Hesitation or disorganized preparation is delaying a tangible opportunity from landing.
blocked.zh: 犹豫拖延或准备零散，让原本可落地的机会迟迟未能兑现。

excess.en: Chasing quick money or overextending resources before the foundation can support it.
excess.zh: 急于求成或过度透支资源，地基尚未稳固就贸然加码。

internalized.en: Doubting you deserve stability or quietly fearing that good fortune will slip away.
internalized.zh: 暗自怀疑自己配不上安稳丰盛，或隐隐担心好机会终会落空。

release.en: Passing on a flashy but hollow deal to wait for an offer with real substance.
release.zh: 主动放弃华而不实的诱饵，把筹码留给真正有含金量的机会。

message.en: Before you plant anything, test the ground: an idea this promising deserves a real plan, honest numbers, and a start date you can actually keep.
message.zh: 落种之前先验一验土：这么有苗头的想法，值得配上一份像样的计划、一本诚实的账，和一个你真能守住的启动日期。

foundation.en: An earlier opening was let slip, or a venture was launched before the money and planning could carry it, and that shaky start still shapes where you stand.
foundation.zh: 早先有个机会被放走了，或是一件事在资金与规划还撑不住时就匆忙上了马，那个不稳的开头至今仍影响着你的处境。

present.en: The opportunity is real but not landing: preparation is scattered, the practical footing is thin, and the seed is still sitting in your palm instead of the soil.
present.zh: 机会是真的，却迟迟落不了地：准备东一块西一块，现实底子偏薄，那颗种子还攥在手心里，没有真正入土。

challenge.en: Rushed execution or poor resource planning is undermining an otherwise solid prospect.
challenge.zh: 仓促上马或资源盘点不清，正在削弱一个原本不错的机会。

resource.en: What you can still use is the lesson of the last false start: you now know exactly which gaps—budget, timing, follow-through—to close before trying again.
resource.zh: 眼下仍用得上的，是上一次没起好头换来的教训：你已经清楚再试之前该先补哪几处——预算、时机，还是后续的执行。

action.en: Audit the numbers, tighten your budget, and fix the missing operational link before committing money or signing.
action.zh: 先核清账目、收紧预算，补齐缺失的执行环节，再掏钱或签字。

outcome.en: Progress slows until the practical groundwork is repaired; a short pause now saves costly rework later.
outcome.zh: 在现实基础补牢前，进展会放缓；此刻主动停下来补课，能省去日后高昂返工。

advice.en: Do not confuse a delayed harvest with a barren field—recheck the soil and terms before planting.
advice.zh: 别把延迟落地当成全盘无望——落种前先重新核查土壤与条款。

hidden.en: Ask whether a quiet belief that you do not deserve stability is behind the delays—sometimes the paperwork stalls because part of you expects the offer to vanish.
hidden.zh: 不妨问问自己，一再拖延的背后是否藏着“我配不上安稳”的念头——有时手续迟迟不办，是因为心里某处早就认定这机会迟早落空。

self.en: You are standing with one foot in and one foot out—interested in the opening, but hesitant, under-prepared, or half-expecting it to fall through.
self.zh: 你现在是一只脚在门里、一只脚在门外——对机会有兴趣，却迟疑不决、准备不足，或者心里已半信它会黄。

other.en: The other party may be promising more than they can currently back up; their offer looks appealing but appears thin on specifics, funds, or follow-through.
other.zh: 对方许下的可能比眼下能兑现的要多；这份提议看着诱人，可在细节、资金或后续落实上似乎都还单薄。

external.en: Outside conditions are less ready than they look: funding is tight, the window is narrowing, or the deal on offer has more shine than substance.
external.zh: 外部条件没有看上去那么成熟：资金面偏紧，窗口期在收窄，或者摆在面前的交易光鲜有余、实质不足。

hopes_fears.en: You hope a better, more solid offer is still coming, yet fear you have already let the real one pass—or that committing now would expose how unprepared you are.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着后面还有更靠谱的机会，却又怕真正的那一个已经被自己放走，或怕此刻一旦投入，就会暴露自己准备得有多不够。

general.en: Slow down and check the practical math. Either an offer needs sharper vetting, or your own groundwork needs shoring up before you commit.
general.zh: 星币王牌逆位提醒你放慢半拍核对现实账本：要么眼前的机会需要更严格的尽调，要么你自己的基础准备还需要先加固。

love.en: In love, reversed Ace of Pentacles highlights mismatched practical timelines, financial stress, or reluctance to invest real consistency.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提示双方现实节奏错位、外部物质压力偏重，或某一方迟迟停留在口头承诺而不愿给出稳定持续的投入。

career.en: At work, watch for underfunded plans, vague compensation, or a missed opportunity due to slow follow-up. Verify ROI and terms in writing.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，警惕预算不足的方案、含糊的回报承诺或因跟进太慢错失良机。把收益与条款落到纸面再决定。

health.en: Skipping basic physical maintenance—hydration, rest, checkups—erodes resilience; return to one simple daily anchor.
health.zh: 忽略最基础的身体维护（饮水、睡眠、体检）会悄悄透支底气；先恢复一个最简单的日常锚点。

spirituality.en: Notice where floating in pure theory disconnects you from embodied life; ground your insights in one small physical act.
spirituality.zh: 觉察自己是否停留在抽象空泛的灵性理念里却脱离了真实生活；用一件具体踏实的日常小事把内在洞见真正落回地面。

archetypeEssence.en: Agile balance in motion—juggling shifting priorities with rhythm, humor, and light feet.
archetypeEssence.zh: 动态中的灵巧平衡——带着节奏感与轻盈步法，在起伏之间稳稳腾挪。

en: Playful juggler balancing two golden pentacles in opposite hands
Glowing infinity ribbon looping continuously around both coins
Tall rolling ocean waves rising and falling behind the figure
Two sailing ships riding the crest and trough of the shifting sea
zh: 双手一高一低灵巧抛接两枚古金星币的杂耍者
连续缠绕两枚星币的无限循环丝带
身后翻涌起伏的高大浪涛
在浪峰与浪谷间稳健航行的两艘帆船

en: Lithe Belle Epoque acrobat in emerald-and-ochre tunic dancing lightly on a moonlit coastal quay
Exactly two gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coins balanced in left and right hands
Luminous golden infinity ribbon weaving in a continuous figure-eight around both pentacles
Two distant sailing vessels riding dramatic midnight-indigo and sunlit-ivory ocean swells behind the dancer
zh: 身着祖母绿与赭金舞衣、在月色海岸石堤轻盈起舞的美好年代杂耍者
左右手清晰托举抛接的恰好两枚浮雕古金星币
以清晰“8”字无限轨迹环绕两枚星币的流光金带
后方在午夜蓝与象牙白浪涛中起伏前行的两艘帆船

core.en: Two of Pentacles is skilled adaptability: keeping two competing demands alive through rhythm, prioritization, and good-humored flexibility while the tide keeps moving.
core.zh: 星币二代表游刃有余的动态调适：在浪潮持续起伏的环境里，靠节奏感、主次切换与好心态同时稳住两头事务。

message.en: Treat balance as a live dance rather than a frozen spreadsheet—adjust your cadence as conditions shift.
message.zh: 把平衡当成动态起舞而不是僵死表格——随环境起伏灵活调整自己的节奏。

foundation.en: Managing overlapping roles, budgets, or timelines trained you to stay nimble under changing currents.
foundation.zh: 过去同时兼顾多重角色、预算或时间线的经历，练就了你临机应变的身手。

present.en: You are actively juggling two real commitments; you can keep both aloft if you protect your rhythm and avoid adding a third.
present.zh: 你眼下正同时托着两件要事；只要守住节奏、不再随意加塞第三件，就能稳稳接住。

challenge.en: Decision fatigue is the snag: every option stays in the air because committing to one keeps getting postponed.
challenge.zh: 卡点在于决策疲惫：所有选项一直被抛在半空，只因迟迟不肯选定其中一个。

resource.en: Your greatest asset right now is agility—the ability to reallocate time, cash, or attention smoothly without panicking.
resource.zh: 你此刻最大的优势是灵活度——能在不慌乱的前提下顺畅调配时间、资金与注意力。

action.en: Time-block your two main priorities clearly, review cashflow weekly, and keep your schedule light enough to absorb one surprise.
action.zh: 为两项核心事务划出清晰时间块，每周复盘一次现金流，日程留得宽松些，足以接住一次意外。

outcome.en: If you keep your rhythm, you are likely to ride out the choppy stretch cleanly, landing both commitments intact with sharper timing and resilience.
outcome.zh: 只要守住节奏，你很可能平稳度过这段起伏期，把两头事务都妥帖接住，节奏感与韧性也随之练得更好。

advice.en: Stay light on your feet and keep your eyes on the rhythm, not just the waves behind you.
advice.zh: 脚步放轻，眼睛盯住手里的节奏，别被身后起伏的浪花吓乱了阵脚。

hidden.en: Look at what the juggling itself might be covering: staying busy with two things can be a way to avoid admitting which one you would choose if you had to.
hidden.zh: 看看这场来回抛接本身可能在遮掩什么：两头都忙着，也许正好让你不必承认，真要二选一时你会选哪一个。

self.en: You are the adaptable one here—switching between demands with good humor, improvising as you go, and trusting your sense of timing to keep things moving.
self.zh: 你是这件事里最能变通的那个人——带着好心态在各项事务间切换，边走边调整，靠自己的节奏感让一切转下去。

other.en: On the other side, someone seems to be balancing you alongside other commitments; they may be flexible and good-natured about it, but their attention is likely divided.
other.zh: 对方似乎正把你和其他事务放在一起兼顾；态度或许灵活又随和，但注意力很可能是分着用的。

external.en: Circumstances around you are in motion—fluctuating income, shifting schedules, changing demands—so the environment rewards flexibility more than fixed plans.
external.zh: 周围的局面一直在变——收入有起伏，日程常调整，要求时时不同——这样的环境更偏爱灵活应对，而不是一成不变的计划。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes to keep both things going without giving either one up; another part fears that one slip in timing would bring the whole act down.
hopes_fears.zh: 一部分的你希望两头都能顾住、哪边也不用放弃；另一部分的你却担心节奏上一个失手，整套平衡就会跟着垮掉。

general.en: Adaptability and steady cadence carry you through shifting circumstances. Keep the two essentials moving smoothly and don't overcomplicate the routine.
general.zh: 灵活应变与稳定节奏会带你穿过变动期。把最关键的两件事顺畅衔接起来，别把流程搞得过度复杂。

love.en: In love, Two of Pentacles calls for balancing romance with work, family, or personal space—keeping playfulness alive while honoring real-world schedules.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币二提醒在亲密与工作、家庭或个人空间之间找到活络的平衡——兼顾现实日程的同时保住轻松趣味。

career.en: At work, you are navigating dual projects, side income, or shifting budgets. Clear weekly cadence and nimble reprioritization keep everything profitable.
career.zh: 在职场上，你可能正并行推进两个项目、兼顾副业或应对预算波动。清晰的周节奏与果断重排优先级能保住产出。

health.en: For wellbeing, alternate effort with recovery like a wave—steady moderation beats rigid all-or-nothing regimens.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，像浪潮一样让发力与恢复交替进行——温和有节律的平衡远胜极端苛刻的打卡。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, equilibrium is not stillness free of waves; it is staying centered while life rises and falls.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的平衡并非风平浪静的一动不动，而是在现实生活的起落波动之间依然保有内在的从容定力与觉知。

core.en: Two of Pentacles reversed signals dropped balls, overcommitment, or financial/schedule whiplash—too many spinning plates for one set of hands.
core.zh: 星币二逆位指向失衡掉拍、过度承诺或收支与日程的剧烈摇摆——同时转动的盘子已经超出了双手的极限。

blocked.en: Disorganization or scattered focus keeps even simple tasks colliding.
blocked.zh: 缺乏条理或注意力分散，让原本简单的事务互相撞车。

excess.en: Saying yes to every request until stress and exhaustion force a drop.
excess.zh: 对每个请求都硬着头皮答应，直到压力与透支逼得你失手。

internalized.en: Performing effortless poise on the outside while privately scrambling to keep up.
internalized.zh: 表面装作游刃有余，私下却焦头烂额地疲于补洞。

release.en: Intentionally setting one ball down so the remaining priority gets real depth.
release.zh: 主动放下一件次要事务，把真正的专注力还给核心要事。

message.en: Something has to come out of your hands. Decide which commitment you will set down on purpose, before overload decides for you.
message.zh: 手里总得放下点什么。趁还由得你挑，主动选定要搁下的那一件，别等到超负荷替你做决定。

foundation.en: A habit of saying yes to everything, or a stretch of lurching money and schedules, left you overextended long before the current wobble began.
foundation.zh: 有求必应的老习惯，或一段收支与日程大起大落的日子，早在眼下这阵摇晃之前，就已经让你铺得太开了。

present.en: Too much is in the air at once: tasks are colliding, a deadline or payment has slipped, and you are reacting to whatever lands next rather than steering.
present.zh: 同时悬在半空的东西太多了：事情互相撞车，某个期限或款项已经脱手，你只是在被动接招，而不是在掌舵。

challenge.en: Over-scheduling and reactive multitasking are draining your focus and budget.
challenge.zh: 塞满的日程与被动多线切换，正在快速掏空你的精力与预算。

resource.en: The dropped ball is useful information—it shows your true capacity. You are also freer than you think to put one thing down and give the rest proper attention.
resource.zh: 掉下来的那个球本身就是有用的信息——它让你看清自己真实的承载量。你也比想象中更有余地放下一件，把心思好好留给其余的事。

action.en: Cut one non-essential obligation today, consolidate your calendar, and automate or defer everything that isn't urgent.
action.zh: 今天就砍掉一项非必要事务，收拢日程表，把不紧急的事项交给自动化处理或直接延后。

outcome.en: Once you stop juggling extras, stability returns quickly and the frantic noise subsides.
outcome.zh: 只要停止强撑多余盘子，稳定感会迅速回归，手忙脚乱的杂音也会退去。

advice.en: Drop the performance of doing it all; pick the one ball that actually matters most this week.
advice.zh: 别再硬演“样样兼顾”的好手；先选出这周真正不能掉的那一枚。

hidden.en: Consider whether the calm, capable front is hiding how close to the limit you are; it is worth checking who actually knows you are scrambling.
hidden.zh: 想一想，那副从容能干的样子是否正掩盖着你离极限有多近；也值得看看，到底有谁真正知道你其实在手忙脚乱。

self.en: You are coming across as stretched thin—agreeing to more than two hands can hold, apologizing for delays, and keeping up a show of coping while privately behind.
self.zh: 你现在给人的感觉是绷得太紧——答应的事超出了两只手能接的量，为拖延一再道歉，面上撑着“还行”，私下却已落后。

other.en: Rescheduling, late replies, running hot and cold: the other party appears overloaded and inconsistent, which may say more about their overfull plate than about you.
other.zh: 改期、迟回消息、忽冷忽热——对方看起来负荷过重、时好时坏，这也许更多说明对方手上的事太满，而未必是冲着你来的。

external.en: More is being asked of you than the situation can reasonably hold: other people's requests keep piling on, and unpredictable timing or bills make it hard to regain a rhythm.
external.zh: 外界压过来的要求已超出合理范围：别人的请求一件件往上堆，时间与账单又难以预料，想找回节奏并不容易。

hopes_fears.en: You hope someone will tell you it is fine to put something down, yet fear that letting go of even one commitment would prove you could not handle it all.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着有人对你说一句“放下一件也没关系”，却又怕哪怕只松手一件，就等于证明自己其实撑不住全部。

general.en: You are stretched too thin. Simplify your commitments and restore basic order before the next wave hits.
general.zh: 星币二逆位说明你同时铺开的战线拉得太长了。在下一波现实变动到来之前，先果断做减法、砍掉低优事项并恢复秩序。

love.en: In love, reversed Two of Pentacles warns that hectic schedules or divided attention are leaving a partner feeling squeezed into leftover margins.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提醒忙碌日程或分散的精力正让伴侣觉得自己只被塞在边角时间里，需要重新留出完整陪伴。

career.en: At work, beware missed deadlines, messy cashflow, or spreading yourself across too many half-finished initiatives. Narrow your focus immediately.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，警惕延期、现金流紊乱或在太多半成品之间反复横跳。立刻收窄战线、聚焦核心。

health.en: Irregular sleep, skipped meals, and constant context-switching are taxing your nervous system; re-establish one predictable daily rhythm.
health.zh: 作息紊乱、凑合应付饮食与频繁切换任务正在持续磨损你的神经系统；先从睡眠与三餐重建一条可预测的日常稳态节律。

spirituality.en: Step off the treadmill of busyness; clarity returns when you stop equating motion with progress.
spirituality.zh: 从停不下来的忙碌惯性里迈下来；当你不再把“忙个不停”等同于“在前进”，清明自然回来。

promptSpec.suitAccent: verdant emerald-verdigris, warm parchment ochre, embossed antique gold pentacle coins, sunlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: A lithe, poised Belle Epoque acrobat in a fitted emerald-verdigris and warm parchment-ochre embroidered tunic with flowing ivory sleeves balances playfully on one foot atop a moonlit stone coastal quay. With outstretched hands—right hand raised high, left hand lowered—the dancer juggles EXACTLY TWO gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coins, each clearly defined with a five-pointed star. A luminous, continuous molten-gold infinity ribbon loops cleanly in a graceful figure-eight around both pentacles. Behind the figure, dramatic curling ocean waves in deep midnight-indigo and shimmering ivory foam rise and fall beneath TWO small sailing ships riding the crest and trough under a luminous twilight sky.

requiredObjects.object: dancing acrobat
embossed golden pentacle coins
glowing golden infinity ribbon
sailing ships on waves

promptSpec.compositionNote: Dynamic S-curve dancer silhouette with EXACTLY TWO bright gold pentacles linked by a luminous figure-eight ribbon framing the center; unmistakable balance motif even at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Craftsmanship honed in public through disciplined collaboration and visible mastery.
archetypeEssence.zh: 在分工协作与反复雕琢中落地成形的专业匠心。

en: Master mason standing on a bench carving a Gothic cathedral arch
Three sculpted pentacles set cleanly into the top of the vaulted stone arch
Architect or patron and monk examining an unrolled blueprint together
Chisel and mallet in the artisan's hands representing skilled execution
zh: 立于长凳上专注雕琢哥特式拱门的工匠大师
规整嵌在石拱顶端的三枚浮雕星币
共阅展开设计蓝图的建筑师或委托人与修士
工匠手中的凿子与木槌，象征扎实技艺与落实

en: Master artisan on a carved wooden bench chiseling a soaring candlelit cathedral arch
Exactly three embossed antique-gold pentacle medallions inlaid in a triangle inside the warm limestone arch
Two collaborators below—a robed scholar and a velvet-cloaked patron—consulting an illuminated parchment blueprint
Emerald-verdigris, warm parchment ochre, and glowing candlelight contrasting against deep midnight cathedral shadow
zh: 立于木凳上雕琢高耸教堂石拱的匠师
以三角阵列规整镶嵌在暖色石拱中的三枚浮雕古金星币
拱下并肩审阅发光羊皮纸蓝图的长袍学者与赞助者
在深邃午夜穹顶阴影中跃出的暖烛光、羊皮纸赭金与祖母绿点缀

core.en: Three of Pentacles honors real craft built with others: aligning on the blueprint, respecting distinct expertise, and letting patient skill produce work that stands on its own.
core.zh: 星币三赞许落地生根的协作匠心：先对齐蓝图、尊重各自专业分工，再用经得起检验的手艺把成果真正做出来。

message.en: Treat this as a craft problem, not a solo performance—review the plan with peers whose skill complements yours and refine the details.
message.zh: 把这件事当作需要打磨的工艺而非个人独角戏——找能力互补的伙伴一起审图、扣细节。

foundation.en: Early competence, structured planning, or a solid working partnership created the foundation you are building on.
foundation.zh: 前期的扎实基本功、清晰规划或靠谱的分工协作，搭起了今天能继续加建的底座。

present.en: Work is visibly taking shape through feedback and iteration; welcome critique from people who know the craft.
present.zh: 作品或计划正借由反馈与迭代显出看得见的形状；坦然接纳懂行人的挑刺与建议。

challenge.en: Perfectionism may be slowing delivery, or it is proving hard to let collaborators share ownership of the design.
challenge.zh: 你可能因过度打磨细节而拖慢交付，或难以放心让协作者共同主导设计。

resource.en: Your leverage comes from complementary skills—pairing hands-on execution with someone else's design eye or sponsorship.
resource.zh: 你手里的杠杆是互补分工——把一线实操与他人的结构视野或资源支持结合起来。

action.en: Put the blueprint on the table: share a concrete draft, agree on clear standards and owners, and execute the next tangible piece.
action.zh: 把蓝图摊到桌面上：拿出一版具体草稿，明确验收标准与各自权责，然后扎实做完下一块。

outcome.en: Kept to this standard, visible and durable progress is likely to earn respect from peers and stakeholders: recognition built on real quality rather than hype.
outcome.zh: 若保持这样的水准，看得见、站得住的阶段成果很可能赢得同行与关键方的认可——那是靠真功夫而非吹捧挣来的口碑。

advice.en: Value feedback over flattery and build to a shared standard; lasting reputation grows stone by stone.
advice.zh: 看重专业反馈胜过表面恭维，按共同标准把每一块石头砌牢；长久声誉正由此累积。

hidden.en: Check whose contribution is going unnoticed here—possibly your own. Solid work may be carrying more of this project than anyone has yet said out loud.
hidden.zh: 留意一下这里有谁的贡献没被看见——也可能就是你自己的。真正撑起这件事的扎实功夫，或许比任何人说出口的都要多。

self.en: You bring real skill and take the work seriously—willing to be seen mid-process, to hear critique, and to fit your part into a larger plan.
self.zh: 你带着真本事来，也把活儿当回事——愿意让人看到做到一半的东西，听得进批评，也肯把自己那一部分放进更大的蓝图里。

other.en: Their role here looks like that of a collaborator or evaluator—examining the work closely, bringing their own expertise, and likely expecting clear standards.
other.zh: 对方在这里的角色像是合作者或评审者——认真端详成果，带来自己的专长，并且很可能期待一套清晰的标准。

external.en: The setting favors teamwork and visible competence: people with different roles are involved, standards are being checked, and good work is likely to be noticed.
external.zh: 眼下的环境看重协作与看得见的真本事：不同角色的人都参与其中，标准有人把关，做得好的活儿也容易被注意到。

hopes_fears.en: You hope your work will be recognized by people who know the craft, yet fear that close inspection might show you are not as skilled as they assumed.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望自己的成果能得到懂行人的认可，却又怕被细细端详之后，显出自己并没有别人以为的那么内行。

general.en: Skilled collaboration and measurable craft move this forward. Align expectations around a shared plan and refine the work through honest peer feedback.
general.zh: 扎实协作与可衡量的工艺水准是破局关键。围绕共同蓝图对齐预期，通过坦诚的专业互评不断打磨。

love.en: In relationships, Three of Pentacles is the quiet art of building a shared life—dividing responsibilities fairly, learning each other's rhythms, and treating partnership as something you actively construct together.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币三代表共同经营生活的踏实默契——合理分工、磨合节奏，把关系当作双方一起用心搭建的作品。

career.en: In work or study, this is a classic card of teamwork, apprenticeship, code/design review, and earning trust through reliable execution. Show your work early and co-own the standard.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，这是典型的团队协作、专业评审与凭借可靠交付赢得信任的牌。尽早展示阶段成果，与伙伴共担质量标准。

health.en: For wellbeing, consistent fundamentals and qualified guidance—a trainer, clinician, or structured program—outperform improvised hacks.
health.zh: 在身心管理上，循序渐进的基础训练与专业人士指导（教练、医师或系统方案），远胜临时起意的偏方。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, devotion shows up in ordinary craft: bringing patience, care, and humility to what your hands shape every day.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性修习上，星币三代表虔敬体现在日常打磨之中：带着耐心、专注与谦逊对待双手每日所造之物，本身就是踏实的修行。

core.en: Three of Pentacles reversed points to misaligned teamwork, cutting corners, or working in silos without a shared blueprint.
core.zh: 星币三逆位指向协作错位、急于求成偷工减料，或各干各的却没有对齐同一张蓝图。

blocked.en: Unclear roles or missing feedback loops are stalling solid skill from landing.
blocked.zh: 权责不清或缺少反馈闭环，让原本不错的能力卡在半路落不了地。

excess.en: Over-polishing trivial details or micromanaging every teammate's chisel.
excess.zh: 在次要细节上过度较真，或忍不住替每个协作者握凿子。

internalized.en: Underestimating your own workmanship or hiding unfinished work out of fear of critique.
internalized.zh: 低估自己的专业水准，或因为怕被挑错而把半成品藏起来不让人看。

release.en: Stepping out of a chaotic committee to rebuild clear ownership and quality standards.
release.zh: 跳出混乱扯皮的多头决策，重新确立清晰的责任人与质量门槛。

message.en: Agree on the plan before adding more effort. The skill in the room is real, but right now it is being spent in separate directions.
message.zh: 先把方案对齐，再往里添力气。在场的人都有真本事，只是眼下各使各的劲，没有用到一处。

foundation.en: Roles were never clearly set or an early stage was rushed, and work that began without a shared plan is the root of today's rework.
foundation.zh: 当初分工没讲清，或是前期赶得太急；一开始就缺一份共同的方案，这正是如今反复返工的根源。

present.en: People are working beside each other rather than with each other: feedback is not circulating, standards differ, and good effort is not adding up to a finished whole.
present.zh: 大家只是并排干活，并没有真正配合：反馈传不起来，标准各不相同，不少好力气凑不成一件完整的成品。

challenge.en: Different people are building from different mental blueprints, creating rework and quiet resentment.
challenge.zh: 不同人按各自脑中的图纸施工，造成返工与隐形摩擦。

resource.en: The individual skills are intact—yours included. A rough draft you have been hiding, shown to one trusted colleague, could be the piece that gets things moving.
resource.zh: 每个人的本事都还在，包括你的。那份你一直藏着的粗稿，拿给一位信得过的同事看看，也许正是让事情重新转起来的那一块。

action.en: Stop building in parallel for one hour: write down who owns what, what 'done' looks like, and which shortcut must be fixed.
action.zh: 先停工一小时把话说透：写清谁负责哪块、完成标准是什么，以及哪个草率角落必须返修。

outcome.en: If roles and standards stay unspoken, the work is likely to keep being redone and goodwill to wear thin; one honest alignment conversation tends to turn that around.
outcome.zh: 如果分工与标准继续没人挑明，返工多半还会重演，彼此的好感也会被磨薄；而一次坦诚的对齐谈话，往往就能扭转这个走向。

advice.en: Stop polishing your own corner and look at the whole structure. Ask for the feedback you have been avoiding, and let others hold their own tools.
advice.zh: 别只顾打磨自己那一角，抬头看看整体结构。去要那份你一直回避的反馈，也让别人自己握好自己的工具。

hidden.en: Consider whether fear of critique is keeping unfinished work out of sight—yours or someone else's—and whether a corner was quietly cut that nobody has mentioned.
hidden.zh: 想想是否有人因为怕被挑错，把没做完的东西藏着不拿出来——可能是你，也可能是别人；又是否有哪处被悄悄省了工序，却没人提起。

self.en: You may be acting as the lone builder who trusts no one else's hands, or as the one who plays down their own work—both stances keep you out of real collaboration.
self.zh: 你在这件事里，要么像个信不过别人手艺的独行工匠，要么总把自己的成果往小里说——这两种姿态，都让你进不了真正的协作。

other.en: The other party appears to be working from their own version of the plan—or hovering over details that are yours to handle—and may not realize how far apart you are.
other.zh: 对方似乎是照着自己那一版方案在做，或是总盯着本该由你负责的细节；彼此的理解差了多远，对方可能还没意识到。

external.en: The surrounding structure is part of the problem: unclear ownership, too many decision-makers, or pressure to deliver fast is making careful work difficult.
external.zh: 问题有一部分出在周围的架构上：权责模糊，拍板的人太多，或是催着快交付的压力，都让细致的工作很难做好。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the group will finally pull in one direction and value what you contribute, yet fear that speaking up about the mess will mark you as the difficult one.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望大家终于能朝一个方向使劲，也看重你的付出，却又怕一旦把这团乱象说破，自己反倒成了那个“难相处”的人。

general.en: Check for mismatched expectations, rushed workmanship, or trying to carry a group effort alone without agreeing on the plan.
general.zh: 星币三逆位提醒你排查协作中的摩擦点：是否存在预期没对齐、仓促应付品质，或在未统一蓝图的情况下独自硬扛团队事务。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Three of Pentacles surfaces lopsided effort or operating like roommates on separate schedules. Re-negotiate shared responsibilities openly.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币三逆位常对应付出失衡或各过各的节奏错位，需要把共同事务的边界与期待重新谈清。

career.en: At work, watch for poor handoffs, ignored reviews, or undervalued craft. Clarify scope and ownership in writing before investing more hours.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕交接断层、敷衍评审或专业付出被轻视。在继续投入工时前，先把范围与权责写清。

health.en: Inconsistent follow-through or skipping foundational habits undercuts results; simplify the routine so you can actually sustain it.
health.zh: 在身心层面，计划断断续续或跳过基础环节会让调理效果大打折扣；把养生与训练方案精简到当下真正能长期坚持的程度。

spirituality.en: Notice where ego or comparison is turning practice into competition rather than steady service.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉察是否因为虚荣、外界掌声与横向比较，把原本沉静踏实的日常修习，扭曲成了急于证明自己的无声竞赛。

promptSpec.suitAccent: emerald-verdigris, warm parchment ochre, glowing amber candlelight, burnished antique gold
promptSpec.scene: An architectural interior beneath a soaring candlelit Gothic-Art Nouveau stone cathedral arch. On the left, a master sculptor in a richly detailed emerald-and-ochre artisan tunic stands on a low carved wooden bench holding a small mallet and chisel, carving the warm sunlit-ivory limestone archway. Inlaid cleanly inside the upper curve of the stone arch are EXACTLY THREE large, distinct, embossed antique-gold pentacle medallions arranged in a crisp, symmetrical triangle. Standing below on the right side of the nave, TWO collaborators—a scholarly figure in a dark emerald cloak and a noble patron in amber-trimmed velvet—hold open an illuminated cream parchment architectural blueprint, pointing upward toward the arch. Warm golden candlelight illuminates the stone arch, the three golden pentacles, the parchment scroll, and the artisan's hands against deep midnight-indigo vaulted shadows.

requiredObjects.object: master sculptor on bench with chisel
collaborators reading blueprint below
embossed golden pentacles inlaid in arch

promptSpec.compositionNote: Strong vertical architectural Gothic arch framing the upper third with THREE bright gold pentacle medallions clearly visible in a triangular triad; completely distinct geometric silhouette and warm amber-emerald palette from Three of Cups even at 64x96 thumbnail.
avoid: extra coins or stars mistaken for pentacles

archetypeEssence.en: Guarded security—holding tightly to what you have built, where prudence borders on rigidity.
archetypeEssence.zh: 紧握不放的安全感——死守已筑成的城池，审慎与僵硬只在一线之间。

en: Crowned figure seated rigidly on a stone bench clutching a pentacle tightly to the chest
One golden pentacle balanced squarely atop the crown
Two golden pentacles pinned firmly beneath both planted feet
Walled prosperous city rising behind the seated figure's back
zh: 端坐于石凳之上、双臂紧抱一枚星币于胸前的戴冠者
稳稳压在头冠之巅的一枚古金星币
被双脚牢牢踩在脚底的两枚古金星币
背倚其后的繁华围城与塔楼剪影

en: Regal, guarded Belle Epoque magnate seated squarely on a carved stone plinth in emerald-velvet and ochre robes
Exactly four embossed antique-gold pentacle coins locked to the body: one perched on the golden crown, one hugged tightly against the chest, and two pinned under the boots
Illuminated walled medieval-Art Nouveau city skyline glowing in warm parchment-gold behind the seated figure
Crisp chiaroscuro rim-light emphasizing the closed posture and gleaming metallic coins against deep midnight-indigo sky
zh: 身着祖母绿天鹅绒与赭金长袍、正襟危坐于石台之上的戒备贵族
紧锁在身体四处的恰好四枚浮雕古金星币：头顶一枚、怀抱一枚、双足各踩一枚
背后在暖金灯火中矗立的围墙古城天际线
利落明暗轮廓光勾勒出紧绷姿态与四枚金属星币，映衬深邃午夜蓝夜空

core.en: Four of Pentacles highlights preservation and control: protecting hard-won resources, saving prudently, and holding firm boundaries—while warning that gripping too tightly freezes both generosity and growth.
core.zh: 星币四聚焦守护与掌控：稳妥看护辛苦挣来的资源、审慎储蓄并立住边界——同时也提醒，抓得太死会同时冻住流动与成长。

message.en: Protect your core reserves wisely, then ask honestly whether you are guarding stability or clinging out of fear.
message.zh: 理智守好核心家底，同时诚实自问：你现在是在稳健防御，还是出于恐惧而死抓不放？

foundation.en: Past scarcity or hard-earned discipline taught you to prioritize security, savings, and self-protection.
foundation.zh: 过往的匮乏经历或咬牙自律，教会了你把安全感、储蓄与自我保护放在首位。

present.en: Your footing is solid and controlled, yet your hands are so full of holding on that nothing new can easily enter.
present.zh: 你的现实底盘稳固可控，但双手抱得太满，新机会与新流动也因此很难进来。

challenge.en: Stubborn possessiveness or fear of losing control is turning healthy prudence into stagnation and isolation.
challenge.zh: 执拗的占有欲或害怕失控的焦虑，正把原本健康的谨慎变成停滞与封闭。

resource.en: Financial discipline, clear boundaries, and conservative risk management are keeping your position safe right now.
resource.zh: 严明的财务纪律、清晰边界与稳健风控，此刻正牢牢护住你的基本盘。

action.en: Ring-fence a clear safety reserve, then intentionally loosen your grip on one controlled area—delegate, invest, or share.
action.zh: 先划出明确的安全底仓，随后有意识地在一件可控的事上松手——去授权、投入或分享。

outcome.en: Material stability holds firm; how alive it feels depends on whether you let resources circulate instead of locking them away.
outcome.zh: 物质底盘依然稳健；但日子是否鲜活，取决于你愿不愿意让资源流动起来，而不是彻底锁进保险箱。

advice.en: Keep your foundation secure without turning your fortress into a cage.
advice.zh: 守住地基的安稳，但别把自己的堡垒修成密不透风的牢笼。

hidden.en: Ask what the tight grip is really protecting. Beneath the careful budgeting or firm boundaries there may be an old fear of loss that has never been examined.
hidden.zh: 问问这份紧握究竟在护着什么。精打细算或界限分明的背后，也许压着一份从未被好好看过的、对失去的旧恐惧。

self.en: You are approaching this guardedly—protective of what you have built, careful with money and trust, and inclined to keep control rather than risk an open hand.
self.zh: 你是带着戒备来面对这件事的——护着自己攒下的一切，对钱和信任都很谨慎，宁可把控制权攥在手里，也不愿冒险松开。

other.en: The other person seems to be holding on tightly—guarded with money, time, or feeling—and is likely to keep their position rather than meet you halfway for now.
other.zh: 对方似乎攥得很紧——在钱、时间或感受上都有所防备——眼下很可能会守着自己的立场，而不是向你迈出半步。

external.en: The climate around you is conservative: budgets are locked down, people are protecting their own positions, and nobody is in a hurry to take risks or loosen terms.
external.zh: 周围的气氛偏保守：预算卡得很紧，人人都在守自己的位置，没有谁急着冒险或放宽条件。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to feel completely secure at last, with nothing left to chance, yet fear that any loosening—spending, sharing, trusting—would let it all drain away.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着终于能彻底安心、什么都不必悬着，却又怕只要稍一松手——花出去、分出去、信出去——一切就会跟着流走。

general.en: Stability and conservation are strong here, but watch where fear of loss makes you overly rigid. True security breathes.
general.zh: 稳健与守成是主调，但留意对失去的恐惧是否让你变得过于僵硬。真正踏实的安全感是可以呼吸与流动的。

love.en: In love, Four of Pentacles flags guardedness, jealousy, or keeping emotional distance to stay safe. Trust grows when you risk a little openness.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币四提示防备心重、占有欲或为了不受伤而刻意保持距离。信任需要在适度敞开中生长。

career.en: At work, this favors conservative budgeting, protecting IP, and holding your ground—yet warns against hoarding tasks or resisting necessary updates.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，它支持稳健预算、守护核心成果与站稳立场——但也提醒别死攥所有事务不放权，或抗拒必要升级。

health.en: Holding tension in your jaw, shoulders, or habits mirrors emotional gripping; gentle stretching and letting go of rigid control help you unwind.
health.zh: 紧绷的肩颈、咬紧的牙关或刻板习惯，往往映照着内心的紧抓；温和舒展与松开过度控制更能帮你卸压。

spirituality.en: Notice where attachment to certainty or possessions narrows your spirit; generosity is a practical antidote to scarcity fear.
spirituality.zh: 觉察对确定性或拥有物的执着是否收窄了心量；适度的给予与分享，正是化解匮乏恐惧的务实解药。

core.en: Four of Pentacles reversed marks a shift in grip—either finally loosening fear-based hoarding to let life flow, or leaking money and boundaries through impulsive spending.
core.zh: 星币四逆位标志握力的变化——要么终于松开出于恐惧的死守让生活重新流动，要么因冲动消费或边界松散而出现漏财。

blocked.en: Clinging even harder as anxiety spikes, refusing every change out of panic.
blocked.zh: 越焦虑越死抓不放，出于恐慌拒绝任何变动。

excess.en: Rebound overspending or reckless generosity that erodes your actual safety net.
excess.zh: 报复性挥霍或失去分寸的慷慨，反而掏空了原本的安全垫。

internalized.en: Quietly realizing that hoarding never cured the underlying fear of not having enough.
internalized.zh: 内心逐渐看清：一味囤积从未真正治好“不够用”的底层不安。

release.en: Unclenching your hands—decluttering, forgiving, investing, and trusting healthy circulation.
release.zh: 主动松开紧握的拳头——断舍离、释怀、合理投入，重新信任健康的流通。

message.en: Your grip is changing, so make it deliberate: open your hand where control has gone stale, and close it where money or boundaries have started to leak.
message.zh: 你的握力正在变化，那就让它变得有意识：在控制已经僵掉的地方松开手，在钱或边界开始渗漏的地方收一收。

foundation.en: A long stretch of holding on too tightly—or a sudden swing into spending after years of restraint—set up the unsettled relationship with security you have now.
foundation.zh: 一段攥得太紧的漫长日子，或是多年克制之后突然的放手花销，造成了你如今与安全感之间这种不踏实的关系。

present.en: Old control is slipping. Either you are finally letting things circulate, or resources and limits are escaping faster than you meant them to—possibly both at once.
present.zh: 旧有的掌控正在松动。要么你终于肯让东西流动起来，要么资源与界限流失得比你预想的快——也可能两者同时在发生。

challenge.en: Swinging between tight scarcity fear and impulsive leaks is destabilizing your sense of security.
challenge.zh: 在过度吝啬的匮乏焦虑与冲动破财之间来回摆荡，正在动摇你的安全感。

resource.en: You have already learned that hoarding never bought real peace. That insight, plus the space freed by letting stale things go, is yours to build on.
resource.zh: 你已经明白，囤得再多也换不来真正的安心。这份领悟，加上放走陈旧之物后腾出的空间，都是你可以借力的东西。

action.en: Clear out what you are only keeping out of fear, and set one simple guardrail on discretionary spending.
action.zh: 清理掉那些只因害怕失去才留着的东西，同时给非必要支出设一条简单护栏。

outcome.en: A healthier flow replaces stagnant clutching once you pair openness with clear financial boundaries.
outcome.zh: 只要把敞开流动与清晰财务边界结合起来，沉闷的死守就会转化为更轻盈的良性循环。

advice.en: Release what has gone stale, but keep your core reserve intact.
advice.zh: 放走已经僵死陈旧的部分，同时守好真正托底的核心储备。

hidden.en: Check for a leak you have not looked at directly—small recurring spending, a boundary quietly given away—or for anxiety that is tightening your grip without your noticing.
hidden.zh: 查一查有没有一处你没正眼看过的漏洞——零碎却反复的花销，或一条悄悄让出去的界限；也留意焦虑是否正在不知不觉中让你越攥越紧。

self.en: You are in the middle of renegotiating your own grip—some days generous and relieved, other days anxious or careless—still working out what safe actually means to you.
self.zh: 你正在重新调整自己握东西的力道——有时大方而轻松，有时又焦虑或大意——还在摸索对你来说什么才算真正的“安全”。

other.en: The other person may be loosening up after a long guarded spell, or swinging between withholding and sudden generosity; their behavior is likely to look inconsistent for a while.
other.zh: 对方可能正从长期的戒备中慢慢松动，也可能在一毛不拔与突然大方之间来回摆动；一段时间内，表现多半会显得前后不一。

external.en: Outside conditions are shaking loose what used to be fixed—a freed-up budget, a lifted restriction, or unexpected costs that test how firm your reserves really are.
external.zh: 外部条件正在松动原本固定的东西——预算被放开，限制被取消，或是突如其来的开销，在考验你的储备究竟有多牢靠。

hopes_fears.en: There is a hope of relaxing your guard and enjoying what you have without counting every coin, alongside a fear that once you let go a little you will not know where to stop.
hopes_fears.zh: 你心里有一份盼望：放下戒备，不必每一分都数着，好好享用已有的东西；也有一份担心：一旦松了一点，就不知道该在哪里停住。

general.en: Check which way the grip broke: are you ready to release stale control, or do you need to plug a quiet leak in your resources?
general.zh: 星币四逆位提醒你分辨眼下的松动：你是准备好了放下陈旧控制，还是需要赶紧堵住一处悄然流失的资源漏洞？

love.en: In love, reversed Four of Pentacles can soften old defenses and welcome vulnerability—or flag insecurity that tries to buy or control affection.
love.zh: 在感情中，它既可能代表卸下旧防备、愿意真诚靠近，也提醒警惕因缺乏安全感而试图用物质或控制绑住对方。

career.en: At work, review recurring expenses and unguarded commitments; if you've been hoarding control, delegate one clear piece this week.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，排查持续漏财的固定开支与含糊承诺；若此前事必躬亲，这周就把一块明确工作放手交出去。

health.en: Letting go of perfectionist rigidity brings real physical relief—just avoid swinging into total neglect of sleep or routine.
health.zh: 放下对饮食、体重或训练计划过度苛刻的自律执念会带来明显松弛——只需留心节奏，避免从一个极端滑向彻底放任作息。

spirituality.en: Practicing non-attachment in small, concrete ways frees energy that fear used to lock up.
spirituality.zh: 在日常具体的小事里持续练习松手与不执着，会把原本被匮乏恐惧牢牢锁死的生命能量与信任感重新释放回流动之中。

promptSpec.suitAccent: verdant emerald-verdigris, warm parchment ochre, embossed antique gold pentacle coins, sunlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: A regal, guarded Belle Epoque magnate sits rigidly upright on a carved limestone block facing forward, wearing a heavy emerald-verdigris velvet cloak trimmed with warm parchment-ochre embroidery and a gleaming antique-gold crown. EXACTLY FOUR large embossed antique-gold pentacle coins are locked firmly to the figure's body: ONE pentacle balanced squarely atop the golden crown, ONE pentacle clutched tightly against the chest with both arms wrapped protectively around it, and TWO pentacles pinned flat beneath the left and right booted feet. Behind the seated figure rises a warmly lantern-lit walled medieval-Art Nouveau city skyline against a deep velvety midnight-indigo night sky. Dramatic chiaroscuro illumination highlights the guarded face, clenched hands, and all FOUR gleaming golden pentacles with unmistakable clarity.

requiredObjects.object: seated crowned magnate
embossed golden pentacle coins (1 on crown, 1 hugged at chest, 2 under feet)
walled city skyline behind figure

promptSpec.compositionNote: Tight, symmetrical vertical fortress silhouette with FOUR bright gold coins placed at crown, chest, and both feet—instantly recognizable even at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Material or emotional scarcity felt in the cold—right beside a lit sanctuary window waiting to be noticed.
archetypeEssence.zh: 寒风中真切感受到的匮乏与孤立——而近旁那扇亮着暖光的窗正等着被抬头看见。

en: Two weary travelers trudging through winter snow in hardship
Warm glowing stained-glass church window bearing five pentacles right behind them
Crutches and threadbare cloaks showing real vulnerability and need for shelter
zh: 顶着寒雪艰难跋涉的两位疲惫旅人
近在咫尺却尚未被抬头留意的暖光五币彩绘花窗
拐杖与单薄衣袍，显露出真实的脆弱与求助需求

en: Two weathered winter travelers in dark cloaks walking through moonlit twilight snow beside an ancient stone cathedral wall
Warm glowing stained-glass cathedral arch window above them illuminated with EXACTLY FIVE radiant golden pentacles
Stark dramatic contrast between cold slate-indigo snowdrifts outside and golden emerald sanctuary warmth shining within reach
Luminous Art Nouveau frost filigree and stone lancet ribs framing the sanctuary window
zh: 两位披着深色斗篷、在月下暮雪中沿古教堂石墙并肩前行的旅人
石墙高处散发温暖金光的哥特花窗，窗内清晰镶嵌着五枚璀璨星币
窗外冷冽靛蓝雪地与咫尺之遥的暖金翡翠庇护所之间强烈的明暗反差
环绕教堂花窗的细腻霜纹与新艺术石雕拱肋

core.en: Five of Pentacles upright speaks honestly of scarcity, worry, or feeling left out in the cold—while reminding you that real shelter and help are closer than pride or tunnel vision lets you see.
core.zh: 星币五正位如实映照物质吃紧、缺乏安全感或被冷落的孤立感，同时也提醒：真正的庇护与援手就在近旁，只是窘迫或自尊让你低头赶路而未抬头求助。

message.en: Look up from the hard road. The strain is real, but so is the lit window beside you—help exists, and asking for it is not a failure.
message.zh: 从难走的路上抬起头来。吃紧是真的，身旁那扇亮着灯的窗也是真的——帮助就在那里，开口求助并不丢人。

foundation.en: A period of real shortage—lost income, illness, rejection, or being left to cope alone—sits behind this situation and still shapes how you expect things to go.
foundation.zh: 一段真实的匮乏期——收入中断、身体抱恙、遭到拒绝，或只能独自硬撑——是这件事的底色，至今仍左右着你对事情走向的预期。

present.en: Things are lean and it feels lonely: resources are short, worry is constant, and you are pushing on with your head down, not yet noticing where support could come from.
present.zh: 眼下手头紧，心里也孤单：资源不够，忧虑不断，你低着头往前硬走，还没留意到支持可能从哪里来。

challenge.en: Hardship is compounded by isolation here. Pride, shame, or the belief that nobody would help keeps you walking past the very door that could take you in.
challenge.zh: 这里的困难因孤立而加重。面子、羞耻，或“反正没人会帮我”的想法，让你一次次从那扇本可以收留你的门前走过。

resource.en: You are not walking entirely alone, and shelter is nearer than it feels: a companion in the same weather, a community service, or someone who would help if they knew.
resource.zh: 你并不是完全独行，庇护也比感觉中更近：一位同在风雪里的伙伴，一处能求助的机构，或一个只要知情就愿意伸手的人。

action.en: Tell one trustworthy person or organization exactly what you are short of and ask plainly for help—today, before the situation gets any colder.
action.zh: 找一个信得过的人或机构，把你到底缺什么原原本本讲清楚，直接开口请求帮助——就在今天，别等情况更冷。

outcome.en: If you keep trudging on alone, the lean stretch is likely to drag and feel heavier than it needs to; reaching toward available help tends to shorten it considerably.
outcome.zh: 如果继续独自闷头赶路，这段紧日子多半会拖得更久、也更沉重；而向近处的援手靠过去，往往能让它短上不少。

advice.en: Do not let hardship convince you that you are unwelcome everywhere. Stay close to whoever is beside you, and let yourself be seen needing something.
advice.zh: 别让困境说服你，以为自己到哪儿都不受欢迎。靠紧身边同行的人，也允许别人看见你确实有所需要。

hidden.en: Check whether a source of help has gone unnoticed because you stopped expecting any. It is also worth asking how much of the cold is shame rather than circumstance.
hidden.zh: 看一看，是否有某个求助的去处因为你早已不抱指望而被忽略了。也值得问问：这份寒意里，有多少来自处境，又有多少其实是羞耻感。

self.en: You arrive worn down and braced for refusal—seeing yourself as the outsider, carrying on stoically, and reluctant to let anyone know how tight things are.
self.zh: 你现在是疲惫的，并且已经准备好被拒绝——把自己看成局外人，咬着牙硬撑，不太愿意让人知道日子有多紧。

other.en: They appear to be struggling themselves—short on money, energy, or warmth to give—and may be pulling back out of strain rather than indifference.
other.zh: 对方自己看起来也在吃力——钱、精力或能给出的温暖都不宽裕——这份退缩可能是出于窘迫，而未必是冷淡。

external.en: Conditions are genuinely harsh at the moment: a tight economy, little slack in the system, or a setting where you have been left outside the circle of support.
external.zh: 眼下的外部条件确实严峻：经济面偏紧，周围几乎没有余裕，或者你所处的环境把你留在了支持圈之外。

hopes_fears.en: You hope someone will notice and open the door without your having to ask, yet fear that if you knocked you would be turned away—or pitied.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着有人能主动发现、替你把门打开，不必自己开口，却又怕真去敲门时，换来的是拒绝，或是怜悯。

general.en: A lean stretch feels isolating, yet support exists nearby if you look up and ask clearly.
general.zh: 星币五正位坦言眼下确实处于捉襟见肘或倍感孤立的低潮期，但支持与暖意就在咫尺之外，抬头开口求助比闷头硬扛更有出路。

love.en: Feeling emotionally out in the cold or worrying together through hardship—honest solidarity beats suffering in silence.
love.zh: 在感情中，双方可能感到彼此情感冷落或正共同面对现实压力——坦诚说出脆弱并选择相濡以沫，远胜过各自关门沉默硬熬。

career.en: Budget squeeze, job insecurity, or feeling excluded from resources; map concrete aid, allies, and lean cashflow steps immediately.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，可能遭遇预算紧张、岗位不安或资源边缘化；请立刻盘点手头可借力的盟友、外部支持渠道与稳健现金流对策。

health.en: Low energy or feeling run down deserves real care and medical/community support rather than toughing it out alone.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，体能透支、受寒疲倦或情绪低落此刻需要切实的照护、规律补给与专业支持，不要再把所有不适藏起来一个人硬挺。

spirituality.en: Scarcity shrinks perspective; humility to receive help opens the door back into warmth.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，匮乏感最容易让人把视野缩得很窄；愿意放下羞耻感、允许自己接受他人的善意与帮助，本身就是走进暖光的门。

core.en: Five of Pentacles reversed is a genuine turn toward recovery: warming up after a lean stretch, finding the right door, accepting help, and rebuilding material or emotional footing.
core.zh: 星币五逆位是切实走向回暖的信号：走出捉襟见肘的低谷、看见并推开那扇亮灯的门、接纳援手，重新站稳现实与心理脚跟。

release.en: Emerging from financial or emotional winter; relief and practical support are entering.
release.zh: 正在走出财务或情感寒冬，松动感与切实帮助开始进场。

blocked.en: Stubborn pride slowing down help that is already offered.
blocked.zh: 碍于面子推迟了其实已经递到眼前的援手。

internalized.en: Shaking off a lingering scarcity mindset even as concrete conditions improve.
internalized.zh: 现实条件已开始好转，内心仍在适应放下匮乏惯性。

excess.en: Overspending in relief before new stability fully settles.
excess.zh: 刚一松口气就急着透支，需要给稳固留出缓冲。

message.en: The worst of the cold is passing. Accept the support that is being offered and let yourself believe the recovery, one practical step at a time.
message.zh: 最冷的一段正在过去。接住别人递来的支持，也让自己一步一步、踏踏实实地相信情况确实在回暖。

foundation.en: You have come through a hard season of shortage or exclusion, and the recovery now under way is built on having survived it and finally reached for support.
foundation.zh: 你熬过了一段匮乏或被排除在外的艰难时期；眼下正在展开的复原，正是建立在挺过来并终于伸手求助的基础上。

present.en: Warmth is returning: money, health, or belonging is slowly improving, help has appeared, and you are stepping in from the cold even if you do not fully trust it yet.
present.zh: 暖意正在回来：钱、身体或归属感在慢慢好转，帮助已经出现，你正从寒风里往屋内走，哪怕心里还不敢完全相信。

challenge.en: The obstacle now is less the hardship than the habits it left: turning down help out of pride, bracing for the next blow, or spending the first relief too fast.
challenge.zh: 如今挡路的与其说是困境本身，不如说是它留下的习惯：碍于面子推掉帮助，时刻防备下一次打击，或是把刚到手的一点宽裕花得太快。

resource.en: Real support has entered the picture, and you have something hard-won of your own: proof that you can get through a lean stretch and know who stood by you.
resource.zh: 实在的支持已经进场，而你自己也攒下了一样来之不易的东西：你证明过自己熬得过紧日子，也看清了谁曾站在你身边。

action.en: Say yes to one specific offer of help this week, and use the first bit of breathing room to rebuild a small cushion rather than to celebrate it all away.
action.zh: 这周就对一份具体的帮助说“好”，并把刚喘过来的这口气先用来重建一小笔缓冲，而不是一高兴全花掉。

outcome.en: If this course holds, conditions are likely to mend visibly: practical support, renewed income or resources, or emotional warmth can bring you back inside from the cold.
outcome.zh: 照这个势头走下去，局面有望切实回暖——现实援助、收入或资源的回流、情感上的暖意，都可能把你从寒风里带回屋内。

advice.en: Let recovery be gradual. You do not have to prove you never needed anyone; receive what is given, and update the old story that there is never enough.
advice.zh: 让复原慢慢来。你不必证明自己从未需要过谁；给到手的就安心收下，也把“永远不够”的旧说法改一改。

hidden.en: Notice whether part of you is still living in the snow. Scarcity thinking can linger after conditions change, and an offer already made may be sitting unanswered.
hidden.zh: 留意一下，是否有一部分的你还留在雪地里。条件变了，匮乏的念头却可能迟迟不走，某份早已递来的好意也许至今还没得到回应。

self.en: You are someone on the mend—more willing to be helped than before, cautiously hopeful, and still relearning how to feel that you belong indoors.
self.zh: 你是一个正在好起来的人——比从前更愿意接受帮助，带着小心翼翼的希望，也还在重新学着相信自己本就属于屋内。

other.en: The other party appears to be recovering from a hard patch of their own, or reaching out a hand toward you—tentatively perhaps, yet in practical, visible ways.
other.zh: 对方看起来正从自己的低谷中恢复，或是在向你伸出手——也许还带着试探，却是以实在、看得见的方式在做。

external.en: Conditions outside you are easing: aid is becoming available, a door that was shut is opening, and the people or systems around you are more ready to help.
external.zh: 外部条件正在缓和：援助开始够得着，原先关着的门正在打开，周围的人或机构也更愿意搭把手了。

hopes_fears.en: Your hope is that the hard times are truly behind you and it is safe to relax; your fear is that the warmth is temporary and you will be back out in the snow before long.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼的是苦日子真的过去了、可以放心松口气；怕的是这份暖意只是一时的，过不了多久自己又会回到雪地里。

general.en: Recovery and practical aid are arriving. Walk through the open door and let go of scarcity fear.
general.zh: 星币五逆位预示低谷松动，切实的复原与外部支持正在靠近。请大方走进面前敞开的门，逐步松开长期紧绷的匮乏焦虑与防备。

love.en: Warmth returns after a lonely stretch; forgiving past distance and letting someone show up for you mends the bond.
love.zh: 在感情中，熬过一段孤单冷淡或现实承压的低谷后，暖意正在回流；适当放下防备允许对方靠近分担，关系迎来真诚修复的契机。

career.en: Financial or job strain starts easing—a lead, mentor, grant, or steadier footing helps you climb out of the dip.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，持续的紧缩压力开始松动——一条新的合作线索、关键贵人相助或更稳健的收支节奏，正带你逐步走出低谷期。

health.en: Energy and resilience begin rebounding after a depleted spell; stay gentle as strength returns.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，经历一段消耗与低潮后，体能、睡眠与心理韧性正稳步回升；顺着恢复的势头温和养护，不必急于求成。

spirituality.en: Rebuilding trust that you do not have to earn shelter through endless struggle.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，你正在重新建立一份踏实的笃定感：你不必靠无休止地吃苦、忍耐或证明自己，去换取被接纳、被支持与内心安稳。

archetypeEssence.en: Measured generosity and fair reciprocity—weighing what is given, what is received, and the balance between them.
archetypeEssence.zh: 有度而公允的施予与回流——在手握天平的往来中，看清给予、接纳与彼此的平衡。

core.en: Six of Pentacles centers on fair exchange: giving from genuine surplus, receiving help with dignity, and keeping generosity balanced by clear terms rather than resentment.
core.zh: 星币六的核心是公允流动：在自身富余时坦然施予，在需要时体面接受，并用清晰尺度守住善意与公平，不让付出变成委屈。

message.en: Let resources circulate fairly—either share what you have in surplus or accept the support being offered without guilt.
message.zh: 让资源公平流动起来——要么大方分享你手头的富余，要么坦然接住递到眼前的支持，不必心怀愧疚。

foundation.en: A timely loan, mentorship, grant, or fair partnership helped stabilize the ground you stand on.
foundation.zh: 一次及时的资助、提携、借款或公平合作，帮你稳住了脚下的局面。

present.en: You are in a season of active give-and-take; keep the scales transparent so everyone knows where they stand.
present.zh: 你正处在资源互通与礼尚往来的阶段；把天平摆在明处，彼此都会更踏实。

challenge.en: Check the power dynamic: is the help truly fair, or does it leave one side subtly indebted?
challenge.zh: 先审视其中的权力不对等：这份帮助是真正公平，还是暗中让一方背上了人情债？

resource.en: Goodwill, patronage, or a balanced network is ready to back you—ask cleanly or pay it forward strategically.
resource.zh: 善意口碑、贵人助力或互惠人脉正站在你这边——坦荡开口，或有策略地回馈同行。

action.en: Make one fair exchange concrete—pay what is owed, set clear terms on a favor, or mentor someone who will put it to real use.
action.zh: 把一笔公平往来落到实处——结清应付款项、把人情边界说清，或帮扶一位真正能用好资源的人。

outcome.en: Kept fair, the exchange tends to restore trust and material ease; what you circulate with integrity is likely to return in kind.
outcome.zh: 往来若能保持公允，信任多半会修复，手头也更宽裕；带着诚意流出的东西，往往会以相近的方式回流。

advice.en: Hold the scales level: generosity without boundaries drains you, and receiving without dignity shrinks you.
advice.zh: 把天平端稳：没有边界的慷慨会掏空你，丢了体面的接受则会让你矮下去。

hidden.en: It is worth checking whether you find giving far easier than receiving, and whether support is already available that you have not let yourself ask for.
hidden.zh: 值得看一看：你是否觉得给予远比接受容易，又是否有一份支持其实早就在那里，只是你一直没让自己开口。

self.en: You come across as fair-minded and ready to share—giving from what you can genuinely spare, or accepting support openly, with a clear sense of what is reasonable.
self.zh: 你在这件事里处事公道，也乐于分享——拿得出的就大方给，需要时也坦然接受，心里对什么算合理有一杆清楚的秤。

other.en: Whoever sits across from you seems to be in a position to give—money, time, access, or backing—and appears to be weighing how much to offer and on what terms.
other.zh: 坐在你对面的人似乎处在能给予的位置上——钱、时间、门路或支持——并且看起来正在掂量给多少、按什么条件给。

external.en: Resources are circulating around you: funding, sponsorship, or goodwill is on offer in this environment, generally distributed by someone with the means to decide.
external.zh: 你周围有资源在流动：这个环境里有资金、赞助或善意可供争取，通常由某位有能力做主的人来分配。

hopes_fears.en: You hope for an exchange that is truly even and for help to arrive when you need it, yet fear ending up beholden—or giving generously and getting nothing back.
hopes_fears.zh: 你期盼一场真正对等的往来，也希望需要时能有人相助，却又怕因此欠下人情，或是自己大方付出后什么也收不回。

general.en: Fair give-and-take unlocks momentum. Whether you are the giver or the receiver today, keep the exchange transparent and respectful.
general.zh: 公平的施与受能打通局面。无论今天你是给予方还是接收方，都让往来保持透明与彼此尊重。

love.en: In love, Six of Pentacles brings balanced care, mutual effort, and showing up for each other's practical needs without keeping a petty ledger.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币六代表双向奔赴的照料与体贴，彼此在现实生活中互相托举，而不斤斤计较。

career.en: At work, this signals fair compensation, funding, mentorship, or a mutually profitable deal. Make sure value delivered and value received match.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，它预示公允的报酬、融资、导师提携或双赢交易。确保产出价值与所获回报彼此匹配。

health.en: For wellbeing, balance output with replenishment—accept help with daily chores or care so you aren't pouring from an empty cup.
health.zh: 在身心调节上，让消耗与补给保持平衡——允许他人分担日常事务，别总是空着杯子还硬往外倒。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, true generosity honors the dignity of both hands; giving and receiving are two halves of the same breath.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的慷慨同时尊重施与受双方的尊严；给予与接纳本就是同一口呼吸的一呼一吸。

core.en: Six of Pentacles reversed exposes lopsided exchange: strings-attached favors, unpaid debts, over-giving until resentful, or unequal power dynamics.
core.zh: 星币六逆位揭露失衡的往来：附带条件的人情、拖欠的账目、过度付出后的委屈，或不对等的权力博弈。

blocked.en: Withholding fair credit, pay, or support—or refusing help when you genuinely need it.
blocked.zh: 吝于给出应得的认可、报酬或支持——或在真正需要时固执拒绝援手。

excess.en: Over-giving to buy approval or stay indispensable while quietly burning out.
excess.zh: 靠不断透支付出来换取认可或维持被需要感，暗自消耗殆尽。

internalized.en: Feeling silently indebted or keeping score in your head instead of naming the imbalance.
internalized.zh: 心里暗自记账或背负沉重人情压力，却迟迟不把失衡说出口。

release.en: Walking away from one-sided arrangements and restoring clean, equal footing.
release.zh: 主动退出单方面消耗的安排，重新立起清爽平等的往来规则。

message.en: Look squarely at who gives, who takes, and what it costs you. An arrangement that only holds together while you stay silent is not a fair one.
message.zh: 正眼看清谁在给、谁在拿，以及你为此付出了什么。一份只有靠你沉默才能维持的往来，算不上公平。

foundation.en: An earlier favor, loan, or uneven partnership left a debt—financial or emotional—that was never settled, and it still tilts how the two sides deal with each other.
foundation.zh: 早先的一次人情、一笔借款或一段不对等的合作，留下了一笔始终没结清的账——金钱上的或情感上的——至今仍让双方的相处歪向一边。

present.en: The give-and-take is uneven right now: one side carries more, pays more, or owes more, and the difference is showing even if nobody has raised it.
present.zh: 眼下的施与受并不对等：有一方扛得更多、出得更多，或欠得更多；即便没人提起，这份差距也已经显露出来。

challenge.en: Hidden strings, unequal effort, or unclear financial terms are tilting the scales.
challenge.zh: 暗藏条件、付出不对等或模糊的财务条款，正在让天平明显倾斜。

resource.en: Your own sense of fairness is still working—that discomfort is accurate data. You also keep the right to renegotiate, to collect what is due, or to step away.
resource.zh: 你心里那杆秤并没有坏——这份不舒服就是准确的信号。你也始终保有重新谈条件、要回应得之物，或干脆抽身的权利。

action.en: Stop subsidizing a one-sided dynamic—put terms in writing, collect what is owed, or decline a favor that costs your autonomy.
action.zh: 停止补贴单向消耗的关系——把条款写明、追回应得款项，或婉拒会让你丧失自主权的人情。

outcome.en: Naming the imbalance clears quiet resentment and resets the relationship onto honest terms.
outcome.zh: 把失衡挑明后，积压的怨气会散去，关系也能重新回到坦荡平等的轨道。

advice.en: Check the fine print on every 'gift' and stop giving what you cannot afford to give freely.
advice.zh: 看清每份“馈赠”背后的隐形代价，也别再勉强给出自己其实给不起的东西。

hidden.en: Check for unspoken conditions on what is being given, and for a tally you may be keeping in your head. Ask, too, whether generosity is being used to stay needed.
hidden.zh: 查一查这份给予背后有没有没说出口的条件，以及你是否在心里默默记着一本账。也问问自己：这份慷慨，是不是在用来维持“被需要”。

self.en: You may be playing the over-giver who cannot say no, or the one too proud to accept help—either way, your own needs are not making it onto the scales.
self.zh: 你在这件事里，可能是那个不懂拒绝的过度付出者，也可能是放不下面子、不肯受助的人——无论哪一种，你自己的需要都没被放上天平。

other.en: Their giving appears to come with conditions, or they may take more than they return; watch what they actually do with debts and promises rather than what is said.
other.zh: 对方给东西时似乎带着条件，或者拿走的比还回来的多；与其听怎么说，不如看对方实际上怎样对待欠下的账与许下的承诺。

external.en: The wider setup is not level: pay, credit, or support is unevenly distributed, and whoever controls the resources may be setting terms that favor themselves.
external.zh: 整个大环境本身就不平：报酬、功劳或支持的分配并不均匀，掌握资源的一方定下的规则，可能更偏向自己。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to be treated fairly without having to demand it, yet fear that raising the imbalance will cost you the relationship—or reveal how much you have been keeping score.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望不必开口去争，就能被公平对待，却又怕一旦提起这份失衡，会赔上这段关系，或暴露出自己其实一直在心里记账。

general.en: Rebalance the scales. Address one-sided obligations, unpaid debts, or generosity that has quietly turned into leverage.
general.zh: 星币六逆位提醒你重新校准天平。正视单方面透支、未结清的账目，或已经变味为筹码的“好意”。

love.en: In love, reversed Six of Pentacles flags one partner doing most of the emotional or financial lifting, or using favors as subtle control.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提示某一方承担了绝大多数情绪或物质重担，或有人把付出当作隐形拿捏的筹码。

career.en: At work, watch for underpayment, unpaid scope creep, or favors with political strings attached. Renegotiate terms cleanly.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，警惕薪酬不公、无偿加活或附带职场人情债的资源。干脆利落地重新谈清条件。

health.en: Putting everyone else's needs ahead of your own recovery is draining your reserves; put yourself back on the receiving end of care.
health.zh: 长期把别人的需求排在自己休养之前正在悄悄掏空身心底气；收回过度透支的善意，把自己重新放回被认真照料的位置。

spirituality.en: Notice where martyr-like giving masks a fear of not being loved for who you are.
spirituality.zh: 诚实觉察那种带有牺牲感的讨好式付出背后，是否仍藏着“如果不持续证明有用与付出，就不配被爱”的陈旧匮乏信念。

core.en: Seven of Pentacles is the honest mid-course review: real effort has already produced visible buds, and now patience, measurement, and smart pruning matter more than frantic extra labor.
core.zh: 星币七代表诚实的中盘复盘：此前的扎实投入已经结出看得见的雏形，此刻比埋头苦干更重要的，是耐心评估、看清回报率并做精准修剪。

message.en: Pause and evaluate your yield before pushing harder—what you planted is growing, just on an organic timeline.
message.zh: 在继续加码前先停下来盘点收成——你种下的东西正在生长，只是它需要自然的成熟周期。

foundation.en: Months of quiet, unglamorous groundwork brought this venture to its current stage of visible growth.
foundation.zh: 过去数月默默无闻的扎实耕耘，把这件事推到了如今初见成效的阶段。

present.en: You are in the waiting-and-weighing window: far enough along to see real results, early enough to adjust what isn't paying off.
present.zh: 你正处在等待与权衡的窗口期：走得够远已能看见苗头，也还来得及调整不划算的分支。

challenge.en: Restless doubt is the trap: pulling up the roots too early just to check whether they are growing.
challenge.zh: 陷阱在于焦躁的怀疑——总忍不住提前把根拔出来，看看到底长没长。

resource.en: Long-horizon patience and an eye for compounding returns are your sharpest advantages right now.
resource.zh: 放眼长线的耐心以及识别复利回报的眼光，是你眼下最锐利的优势。

action.en: Review your metrics honestly: keep tending the branches that show real fruit and prune one low-yield effort.
action.zh: 诚实复盘关键指标：继续照料已经结果的主枝，果断修剪掉一条低回报的旁枝。

outcome.en: If you stay patient, this tends toward a steady, sustainable harvest: not overnight fireworks, but durable results worth the wait.
outcome.zh: 只要沉得住气，事情多半走向稳健可持续的收获——不是一夜烟火，而是值得等待、经得起时间的扎实回报。

advice.en: Measure by seasons, not days; trust compounding while staying willing to refine your method.
advice.zh: 以季节而不是以天来衡量进展；信任复利，同时保留优化方法的清醒。

hidden.en: Growth may be happening below the surface where you cannot yet measure it. Check, too, for a quiet doubt about whether this is still what you want to harvest.
hidden.zh: 生长也许正发生在你还量不到的地表之下。也顺便看看，心里是否藏着一丝疑问：这是否仍是你想收获的东西。

self.en: You are the patient investor in this—someone who has put in real work, is willing to wait, and is now standing back to judge honestly what it has produced.
self.zh: 你在这件事里是个有耐心的长线投入者——下过真功夫，也等得起，此刻正退后一步，老老实实地评估自己到底种出了什么。

other.en: The other person appears to be taking stock rather than acting—weighing what they have invested so far and likely not ready to commit further until they see results.
other.zh: 对方看起来是在盘点而不是行动——掂量自己至今投入了多少，在看到成效之前，很可能还不打算进一步表态。

external.en: This is a slow-growth phase set by forces outside you: markets, approvals, or other people's timelines are ripening at their own pace and cannot be rushed.
external.zh: 这是一段由外部节奏决定的慢生长期：市场、审批或别人的时间表都在按各自的速度成熟，催不得。

hopes_fears.en: The hope is that the long effort pays off in a harvest that justifies the wait; the fear is that you have spent the season on something that will never fully ripen.
hopes_fears.zh: 盼的是这番长久的付出能换来一场配得上等待的收成；怕的是自己把整整一季都耗在了一件终究熟不透的事上。

general.en: Step back and assess your return on effort. Good work is ripening—pair patience with calm, objective pruning.
general.zh: 先退后一步冷静评估过往投入与当前产出比。扎实成果正在慢慢成熟——把沉得住气的耐心与务实精准的微调结合起来。

love.en: In love, Seven of Pentacles invites taking stock of where a relationship is heading—honoring the slow trust you've built while asking if both of you are tending the same garden.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币七邀请你盘点关系的走向——珍视慢慢积累的信任，同时确认双方是否在共同照料同一座花园。

career.en: At work, this is a quarterly review moment: investments, skills, or long projects need patience to mature, plus a clear-eyed check on what deserves more runway.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，这是典型的阶段复盘时刻：长期项目、技能或投资需要时间发酵，也值得冷静评估哪些方向该继续加注。

health.en: For wellbeing, sustainable physical change happens slowly; track subtle gains in stamina and sleep rather than demanding instant transformation.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，真正稳固的改善往往润物细无声；多留意体能与睡眠的细微回升，别苛求立竿见影。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, waiting is active soil work—learning to stay present in the quiet middle between planting and harvest.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，等待本身就是扎实的培土工夫——学会在播种与收获之间安静的留白期安住当下。

core.en: Seven of Pentacles reversed points to impatience, sunken-cost frustration, or pouring effort into a patch that isn't yielding—time to pivot instead of forcing barren ground.
core.zh: 星币七逆位指向急躁失衡、沉没成本带来的焦灼，或把力气耗在不结果的田地里——该果断调整方向，而非死磕贫瘠土壤。

blocked.en: Doubting your own progress so much that you stall right before the payoff.
blocked.zh: 过度怀疑自己的进展，反而在临近收获前停了下来。

excess.en: Overworking the same flawed approach and expecting different fruit.
excess.zh: 沿着同一套低效打法加倍苦干，却指望结出不同果实。

internalized.en: Quietly resenting how long something is taking while still afraid to walk away.
internalized.zh: 暗自怨怼耗时太久，却又因舍不得沉没成本而不敢转身。

release.en: Cutting a low-yield commitment cleanly so your energy returns to fertile work.
release.zh: 干脆利落地砍掉低回报投入，把精力重新收回真正肥沃的事上。

message.en: Be honest about what this is actually returning. More effort is not the answer if the method or the ground is wrong—decide whether to change approach or let it go.
message.zh: 老老实实看清这件事到底回报了你什么。如果方法或土壤本身不对，再加力气也没用——该决定是换个做法，还是就此放手。

foundation.en: A great deal of time or money has already gone into this with little to show for it, and that history of investment is making a clear decision harder now.
foundation.zh: 这件事已经投进去大量时间或金钱，却没换来多少成果；正是这段投入的历史，让现在很难干脆地做决定。

present.en: Effort and reward are out of step. You are tired of waiting, frustrated by thin results, and unsure whether the problem is your timing, your method, or the field itself.
present.zh: 付出与回报对不上拍。你等得疲了，为稀薄的成果而焦躁，也说不清问题出在时机、方法，还是这块地本身。

challenge.en: Impatience or attachment to sunk costs is clouding your judgment about what is actually working.
challenge.zh: 急于求成或恋战沉没成本，正在遮蔽你对“什么真正有效”的判断。

resource.en: Nothing you put in was wasted as experience: you now know what does not grow here. The time and energy tied up in a low-yield effort can be recovered and replanted.
resource.zh: 投进去的一切，至少都成了经验：你现在知道这里长不出什么。困在低回报事务里的时间与精力，也还能收回来另种一片。

action.en: Set a clear review deadline: if a project or habit still shows zero traction by then, stop watering it and reallocate.
action.zh: 立一个明确的复盘期限：如果到期仍毫无起色，就停止继续浇水，把资源重新配置。

outcome.en: Redirecting wasted effort frees immediate relief and opens a far more productive path.
outcome.zh: 把无效消耗抽回来后，紧绷感会立刻松开，也会腾出通往更高产出路径的空间。

advice.en: Do not confuse stubbornness with patience—know the difference between slow growth and a dead end.
advice.zh: 别把死磕错当成耐心——分清“缓慢生长”和“此路不通”的区别。

hidden.en: Ask whether you are staying because it is working or because leaving would mean admitting the cost. Unspoken resentment about the wait may be shaping your judgment.
hidden.zh: 问问自己：留下来是因为它真的有起色，还是因为一走就得承认那些付出收不回。对漫长等待没说出口的怨气，也可能在左右你的判断。

self.en: You are impatient and second-guessing yourself—either working harder at the same thing out of stubbornness, or close to quitting just before you can tell if it pays.
self.zh: 你现在既急躁又反复自我怀疑——要么出于倔强在同一件事上越干越猛，要么在还看不出值不值的时候就快要撒手。

other.en: The other party may be losing patience with how slowly things are moving, or appears to keep investing in an approach that is visibly not working.
other.zh: 对方可能对事情推进得这么慢渐渐失去耐心，或者看起来仍在一套明显不见效的做法上继续投入。

external.en: The return you were counting on is delayed or smaller than promised—poor conditions, a slow market, or a partner's inaction—through no fault of your own effort.
external.zh: 你原本指望的回报被推迟了，或比说好的少——行情不佳、市场迟缓，或合作方按兵不动——这并不是你不够努力造成的。

hopes_fears.en: You hope a little more persistence will finally make it all worthwhile, yet fear that walking away now would turn everything you invested into a loss.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望再坚持一下，一切就终于值得了，却又怕此刻转身离开，会让先前投入的全都变成亏损。

general.en: Check whether you are abandoning a good plant too soon out of impatience, or watering a dead branch out of habit.
general.zh: 星币七逆位提醒你分清两种偏差：你是因急躁差点过早放弃好苗子，还是出于惯性还在给枯枝浇水？

love.en: In love, reversed Seven of Pentacles surfaces frustration over slow emotional returns or questioning whether your investment is truly mutual.
love.zh: 在感情中，它映照出对迟迟不见回应的疲惫，或开始认真审视这段投入究竟是不是双向的。

career.en: At work, audit projects with poor ROI, missed milestones, or endless busywork. Pivot your strategy rather than doubling down on a weak bet.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，果断盘点回报率低、反复延期或空耗工时的项目。调整打法，别在弱势筹码上继续加注。

health.en: If a wellness plan leaves you drained instead of stronger, stop forcing it and switch to something your body actually responds to.
health.zh: 如果某套锻炼、节食或养生方案坚持一阵反而让你越练越虚，就别为了沉没成本硬撑照搬，换回身体真正买账的节奏。

spirituality.en: Release the urge to micromanage timing; trust what is alive and let go of what has run its course.
spirituality.zh: 松开对成长时间表的焦虑掌控；温和地信任仍在暗处扎根生长的部分，同时坦然放下那些已经走到尽头的陈旧执念。

archetypeEssence.zh: 潜心打磨的匠人精神——借由沉静重复与毫不敷衍的专注，把功夫练成真本事。

core.en: Eight of Pentacles honors deliberate practice: shutting out noise, refining one craft piece by piece, and letting steady diligence build skill nobody can counterfeit.
core.zh: 星币八赞许沉心蓄力的刻意练习：屏蔽浮躁杂音，一枚接一枚地打磨手艺，让日复一日的扎实功夫沉淀为谁也拿不走的硬实力。

message.en: Put your head down and do the reps—quality repetition right now matters far more than chasing a shortcut.
message.zh: 沉下心把基本功练透——眼下高质量的重复打磨，远比到处找捷径更管用。

foundation.en: Quiet study, disciplined training, or consistent daily effort built the competence carrying you today.
foundation.zh: 过往默默无闻的研习、系统训练或每日坚持，铸就了你今天站得住脚的专业底气。

present.en: You are in a productive groove of deep work; protect uninterrupted hours so your craft can compound.
present.zh: 你正处在高效深耕的心流期；护住不被打断的整块时间，让手艺稳步复利。

challenge.en: The danger is getting lost in routine execution without lifting your head to check the larger direction.
challenge.zh: 危险在于埋头做惯常的活儿太久，却忘了抬头核对大方向。

resource.en: Your greatest edge is work ethic paired with attention to detail—you actually finish what others only sketch.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是踏实肯干加上细节把控——别人只画草图，你能真正把它做精做完。

action.en: Pick one high-value skill or deliverable, block daily focused sessions, and refine each iteration with clear standards.
action.zh: 选定一项最值钱的核心技能或作品，每天划出专注时段，按清晰标准一版一版精修。

outcome.en: Keep at it and visible mastery and a stronger portfolio are likely to emerge; people tend to notice the unmistakable polish of work done with care.
outcome.zh: 坚持下去，看得见的精湛功力与更扎实的作品集有望成形——用心做出的好活儿，那份打磨过的质感往往会被人看见。

advice.en: Fall in love with the craft itself; steady polish beats bursts of frantic inspiration.
advice.zh: 爱上打磨本身；细水长流的精进，胜过一时兴起的爆发。

hidden.en: Notice how much skill is quietly accumulating that nobody, including you, has yet tallied. Check as well whether the workbench has become a comfortable place to hide.
hidden.zh: 留意一下，有多少本事正在悄悄累积，却还没人算过——包括你自己。也看看这张工作台是否已变成一处舒服的藏身之所。

self.en: You show up as the dedicated worker—head down, absorbed in getting it right, more interested in improving the craft than in being noticed for it.
self.zh: 你是那个埋头实干的人——沉下心，专注于把事情做对，比起被人注意，你更在意把手艺再练精一点。

other.en: Work or training seems to have the other person's full attention; they are likely diligent and sincere in effort, though little appears left over for anything else right now.
other.zh: 工作或进修似乎占去了对方的全部注意力；做事多半勤恳认真，只是眼下腾不出多少心思给别的事。

external.en: The environment rewards diligence and skill over flash: there is steady work to be done, standards to meet, and room to improve through practice.
external.zh: 这个环境看重勤勉与技术，而不是花哨：有稳定的活儿要做，有标准要达到，也有通过练习不断进步的空间。

hopes_fears.en: You hope steady practice will make you genuinely excellent at this, yet fear that however many hours you put in, the work will still fall short of the standard.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望日复一日的练习能让自己真正出类拔萃，却又怕无论投入多少小时，做出来的东西还是够不上标准。

general.en: Focused diligence and skill-building are your best levers. Show up consistently, refine the details, and let the work speak.
general.zh: 专注勤勉与日复一日的技能打磨是你此刻最稳妥的杠杆。保持稳定出勤、反复精修细节，让扎实的成品替你自己说话。

love.en: In love, Eight of Pentacles shows devotion expressed through steady effort—learning how to listen better, showing up reliably, and tending small daily habits that keep trust strong.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币八体现为落在日常里的用心经营——认真倾听、稳定兑现，用点滴细微习惯把信任越养越牢。

career.en: At work, this is apprenticeship, upskilling, deep technical polish, and building a reputation for rock-solid craftsmanship. Mastery pays dividends here.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，这是精进专业、考证深造与靠过硬交付建立口碑的黄金期。扎实手艺会直接转化为长期溢价。

health.en: For wellbeing, consistent micro-habits—daily mobility, steady sleep hours, mindful nutrition—compound into durable strength.
health.zh: 在身心管理上，每天雷打不动的小习惯（拉伸、规律睡眠、踏实饮食）会复利成稳健体魄。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, repetition with presence turns ordinary work into moving meditation.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，当你带着全神贯注的觉知去反复打磨眼前的日常事务，平凡的手艺与劳作本身就是最扎实的流动静心修习。

core.en: Eight of Pentacles reversed flags either perfectionist paralysis, bored corner-cutting, or grinding hard on busywork that no longer grows your craft.
core.zh: 星币八逆位提示完美主义卡壳、厌倦后的敷衍赶工，或在不再带来成长的机械杂务里空耗精力。

blocked.en: Perfectionism or fear of shipping keeps you endlessly tweaking instead of finishing.
blocked.zh: 过度追求完美或害怕交卷，让你在细节里无限打转却迟迟不收尾。

excess.en: Workaholic tunnel vision—grinding for its own sake until craft turns into joyless drudgery.
excess.zh: 工作狂式的隧道视野——为了苦干而苦干，直到把手艺熬成毫无乐趣的苦差。

internalized.en: Quietly doubting your competence despite evidence of real skill.
internalized.zh: 明明已有扎实积累，内心却仍隐隐觉得自己不够格。

release.en: Stepping away from dead-end drudgery to invest your focus in work that actually stretches you.
release.zh: 跳出毫无成长空间的机械消耗，把专注力投向真正能让你精进的新课题。

message.en: Ask what all this effort is for. Finish what is good enough, stop rushing what deserves care, and drop the busywork that teaches you nothing.
message.zh: 问问这一切努力到底为了什么。够好的就收尾交出去，值得用心的别再赶工，学不到东西的杂务就放下。

foundation.en: Somewhere back along the way the work turned mechanical—long hours of repetition without growth, or standards that slid once interest faded.
foundation.zh: 回头看，不知从哪一段起，这份工作变得机械了——长时间重复却没有长进，或是兴趣淡去之后，标准也跟着滑了下来。

present.en: You are busy without getting better: tweaking details that do not matter, hurrying through the parts that do, or going through the motions with little pride in the result.
present.zh: 你很忙，却没有进步：在无关紧要的细节上反复修改，在真正要紧的地方匆匆带过，或只是走个流程，对成品已没多少自豪感。

challenge.en: Sloppy shortcuts or obsessive nitpicking is undermining both quality and momentum.
challenge.zh: 敷衍省事或死抠无关紧要的细节，正在同时拖垮质量与进度。

resource.en: The skill you built is real and does not vanish in a slump. Boredom is useful too—it points to exactly where the work has stopped stretching you.
resource.zh: 你练出来的本事是真的，不会因为一时低迷就消失。厌倦感也有用处——它恰好指出这份工作在哪里已不再让你成长。

action.en: Set a 'good enough to ship' bar on one stalled piece, or stop repeating a rote task that no longer teaches you anything.
action.zh: 为一件卡住的作品定下“可交付标准”立刻交卷，或果断停掉一项不再让你成长的机械活儿。

outcome.en: Refreshing your method restores pride in the work and breaks the monotonous rut.
outcome.zh: 调整打法后会重新找回对作品的自豪感，也能顺利跳出沉闷的重复循环。

advice.en: Aim for honest craft, not neurotic perfection—and make sure the bench you sit at still leads somewhere.
advice.zh: 追求扎实手艺而非焦虑的完美主义——同时确认你埋头耕耘的这张工作台，依然通往你想去的地方。

hidden.en: Check whether fear of being judged is what keeps a piece unfinished, and whether endless hours at the bench are covering a doubt about your own competence.
hidden.zh: 看看是不是对被评判的恐惧，让一件作品迟迟完不了工；又是否在用没完没了的埋头苦干，掩盖对自己能力的怀疑。

self.en: You are acting as either the perfectionist who cannot hand anything in or the tired worker doing the minimum—and in both cases doubting that your work is good enough.
self.zh: 你现在要么是个什么都交不出手的完美主义者，要么是个只求应付的疲惫工匠——而这两种状态下，你都在怀疑自己做得够不够好。

other.en: Their effort looks half-hearted at the moment—corners cut, details missed—or they may be so buried in work that little seems left for the matter at hand.
other.zh: 对方眼下的投入显得有些敷衍——省工序、漏细节——也可能是整个人埋在工作里，对眼前这件事已拿不出多少心力。

external.en: The work itself may have stopped offering growth: repetitive tasks, quantity valued over quality, or a role with little left to learn are shaping this situation.
external.zh: 这份工作本身可能已给不出成长空间：重复的任务、重量不重质的要求，或一个没多少东西可学的岗位，都在影响眼下的局面。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to feel proud of your work again and to find it leading somewhere, yet fear that you have peaked—or that putting it out unfinished would expose its flaws.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望重新为自己的作品感到骄傲，也看到它通往某个方向，却又怕自己已到了顶，或怕不够完美就拿出去，会把毛病全亮给人看。

general.en: Check whether you are rushing past fundamentals or over-polishing out of fear. Reconnect effort with purpose.
general.zh: 星币八逆位提醒你检查两极：是在敷衍跳过基本功，还是出于焦虑过度打磨？把努力重新对齐目标。

love.en: In love, reversed Eight of Pentacles warns against putting a relationship on autopilot or nitpicking minor flaws while missing the bigger warmth.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提醒别让关系陷入机械敷衍的惯性，也别总盯住鸡毛蒜皮挑刺而忽略了彼此的温情。

career.en: At work, watch for burnout from repetitive tasks, lack of focus, or perfectionism delaying a launch. Ship clean work and seek fresh challenge.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕重复性杂务带来的倦怠、注意力涣散，或因过度雕琢耽误上线。按标准利落交付，并寻找能提升段位的新挑战。

health.en: Rigid tracking or abandoning basics out of boredom both stall progress; simplify your routine so it feels sustainable again.
health.zh: 过度苛刻的打卡或因枯燥彻底摆烂都会打断节奏；把日常养护精简到重新顺手、愿意坚持的状态。

spirituality.en: When discipline turns mechanical, pause and remember why you began the practice.
spirituality.zh: 当原本滋养你的日常自律退化成毫无生气的机械打卡，不妨停下来安静重温你最初开启这份修习时那份真实而鲜活的初心。

EXACTLY EIGHT gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coins are clearly visible and countable: SIX finished golden pentacles hang neatly in a single vertical column down a tall wooden display post on the left, ONE pentacle is clamped flat on the workbench directly beneath the artisan's chisel, and ONE pentacle rests cleanly on the studio floor beside the bench base. Warm amber workshop lantern light illuminates the artisan's concentrated face, skilled hands, and all EIGHT golden coins against deep midnight-indigo shadows, with distant twilight town spires visible through an arched studio window.

requiredObjects.object: seated goldsmith with hammer and chisel at workbench
embossed golden pentacle coins (6 vertically on post, 1 on workbench, 1 at base)
