archetypeEssence.en: Earned self-sufficiency—walking unhurriedly through the abundant garden you cultivated with your own discipline.
archetypeEssence.zh: 亲手挣来的丰盛自在——从容漫步在靠自己自律与眼光培植出的繁茂庄园之中。

en: Poised woman in an opulent gown strolling calmly through a lush private vineyard
Hooded falcon perched with quiet discipline on her gloved left hand
Nine golden pentacles gleaming amid heavy clusters of ripe grapes and vines
Manor house rising in the sunlit distance symbolizing self-built independence
zh: 身着华美长裙、在私人葡萄园中从容信步的优雅女子
戴着眼罩、驯服停驻在她左手皮套上的猎隼
掩映在累累成熟葡萄与藤蔓间的九枚古金星币
远方晨光中矗立的庄园宅邸，象征独立稳固的家业

en: Sovereign Belle Epoque chatelaine in a flowing warm parchment-ochre and emerald-brocade gown strolling gracefully through a moonlit-and-dawn vineyard
Hooded falcon with antique-gold jesses perched serenely on her raised gloved left hand
Exactly nine gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coins nestled cleanly among lush grape trellises—six clustered on the left trellis and three on the right
Distant ivory-lit manor silhouette and golden-hour rim-light framing her poised autonomy against deep midnight-indigo sky
zh: 身着暖羊皮纸金与祖母绿织锦长裙、在晨昏交织的葡萄园中从容漫步的美好年代庄园女主人
稳稳停驻在她微扬的左手皮套之上、配戴古金脚绊的蒙眼猎隼
清晰点缀在繁茂葡萄花架间的恰好九枚浮雕古金星币：左侧花架六枚、右侧花架三枚
远方泛起象牙白微光的庄园剪影与暖金轮廓光，在午夜蓝天幕下衬出独立气度

core.en: Nine of Pentacles celebrates mature independence: enjoying the comfort, taste, and freedom earned through patient self-command, without needing anyone else to validate your worth.
core.zh: 星币九礼赞成熟的独立丰足：坦然享用凭借长期自律与智慧换来的体面、自由与余裕，不必仰仗他人来证明自身价值。

message.en: Stand proudly in what you have built—savor the quality of your life and protect your hard-won autonomy.
message.zh: 大方站进你亲手筑起的好日子里——细品生活的质感，并守护来之不易的自主权。

foundation.en: Years of self-reliance, prudent choices, and refined standards built the comfortable ground beneath you.
foundation.zh: 过往的自立自强、审慎选择与对品质的坚持，为你铺就了今天从容的底气。

present.en: You are in a season of self-contained abundance—financially steadier, clearer in taste, and free to choose on your own terms.
present.zh: 你正处在自给自足的丰盈期——财务更稳、审美更笃定，可以按自己的尺度做选择。

challenge.en: Ask whether enjoying your walled garden has made you hesitant to let genuine intimacy or collaboration past the gate.
challenge.zh: 问问自己：在这座精致花园里过得太自在，是否也让你不太敢让真正的亲密或合作走进门来？

resource.en: Your strongest asset is disciplined independence: you can fund, steer, and enjoy your own path without rushing into compromises.
resource.zh: 你最硬的底牌是自律换来的独立：你有能力自己兜底、掌舵并享受人生，不必仓促妥协。

action.en: Invest in quality over volume, celebrate a milestone with unhurried pleasure, and keep your financial independence non-negotiable.
action.zh: 选择重质不重量的投入，从容犒劳自己一个阶段成果，同时把经济独立守作不可让步的底线。

outcome.en: On this course, refined stability, financial comfort, and quiet pride are likely to follow: a life that feels both abundant and unmistakably yours.
outcome.zh: 照此走下去，体面安稳、财务余裕与沉静的自豪多半随之而来——一种丰盛且完全属于你的生活状态。

advice.en: Enjoy the fruit you worked for without guilt, and keep the falcon of self-discipline close at hand.
advice.zh: 坦然享用你辛苦挣来的果实，同时把自律这只猎隼稳稳留在手边。

hidden.en: Consider what the composed, self-contained surface leaves unsaid—perhaps a wish for company in the garden, or how much quiet discipline the ease actually takes.
hidden.zh: 想一想，这副从容自足的样子没说出口的是什么——也许是希望园子里有人相伴，也许是这份自在背后其实需要多少不动声色的自律。

self.en: You are self-possessed and independent here—confident in your own standards, comfortable in your own company, and not looking for anyone to rescue or complete you.
self.zh: 你在这件事里沉着而独立——对自己的标准有底气，独处也自在，并不指望谁来拯救你或把你补全。

other.en: The other person appears self-sufficient and discerning; they seem comfortable on their own and are likely to join in only where it genuinely adds to a life they already enjoy.
other.zh: 对方看起来自给自足、眼光挑剔；一个人似乎也过得舒坦，多半只会在确实能为本就满意的生活添彩时，才愿意参与进来。

external.en: Your surroundings are comfortable and secure for now—a stable income, a pleasant setting, the freedom to choose—so little outside pressure is forcing your hand.
external.zh: 你所处的环境眼下舒适而安稳——收入稳定，氛围宜人，有选择的自由——几乎没有外部压力逼着你做决定。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to keep the independence and comfort you have earned, yet fear that opening the gate to someone else would cost you both—or that staying alone is the price of it.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望守住自己挣来的独立与舒适，却又怕为别人打开园门会把两样都赔进去，或怕孤身一人正是这一切的代价。

general.en: Self-sufficiency, cultivated taste, and well-earned ease define this moment. Honor the discipline that made this freedom possible.
general.zh: 自给自足、讲究质感与实至名归的从容丰盛是此刻主调。大方享受成果，并继续珍视那份为你换来真正自由的长期自律。

love.en: In love, Nine of Pentacles favors whole, independent partners who choose each other from fullness rather than neediness—or a deeply satisfying solo chapter.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币九青睐彼此完整独立的伴侣——因丰盈而相吸，而非因匮乏而依附；若单身，也是极舒展丰盛的独处时光。

career.en: At work, this signals strong solo consulting, senior mastery, financial cushion, or a venture finally paying steady dividends. Price your work for its true quality.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，它预示稳健的独立业务、资深专业溢价、充裕缓冲或进入稳定分红期。按真实含金量为自己定价。

health.en: For wellbeing, unhurried self-care—good food, time outdoors, restorative rest—sustains your vitality far better than frantic hustle.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，不疾不徐的精致养护（好食材、户外散步、高质量休养）比拼命内卷更能长久滋养元气。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, gratitude and dignity walk together: savoring beauty mindfully is a form of quiet reverence.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，深沉的感恩与清醒的尊严并行不悖：带着敏锐觉知去细品日常之美与丰盛，本身就是沉静而丰沛的内在修持。

core.en: Nine of Pentacles reversed points to over-reliance on external validation, living beyond your means for appearances, or working so hard for independence that you forget to enjoy it.
core.zh: 星币九逆位指向过度依赖外界认可、为了体面超前消费，或一味拼命追求独立却忘了真正享受生活。

blocked.en: Undervaluing your own achievements or leaning too heavily on someone else's safety net.
blocked.zh: 低估自己的积累，或过度依附他人的安全垫而迟迟不敢独立。

excess.en: Status spending or curating an image of luxury that quietly drains real savings.
excess.zh: 为了撑起精致表象而过度消费，暗中掏空了真正的积蓄。

internalized.en: Feeling lonely inside self-sufficiency or guilty whenever you rest and enjoy comfort.
internalized.zh: 在独立外壳下暗感孤单，或一停下来享受安逸就心生愧疚。

release.en: Dropping performative status symbols to build quiet, genuine financial freedom.
release.zh: 卸下演给外人看的体面标签，回归安静而扎实的财务自由。

message.en: Measure security by what is actually true, not by how it looks. Spend less on impressing others and more on a life you can genuinely sustain and enjoy.
message.zh: 用真实情况而不是外表来衡量安全感。少花点力气去打动别人，多用心经营一种你真正撑得起、也享受得了的生活。

foundation.en: A habit of keeping up appearances, or of depending on someone else's money and approval, shaped this situation long before the cracks became visible.
foundation.zh: 撑场面的习惯，或对他人钱财与认可的依赖，早在裂缝显现之前，就已经塑造了这个局面。

present.en: There is a gap between the polished picture and the real account: comfort is costing more than it should, or independence feels more like isolation or endless work than freedom.
present.zh: 光鲜的画面与真实的账目之间有落差：这份舒适的代价偏高，或者所谓的独立，体会起来更像孤立或无休止的忙碌，而不是自由。

challenge.en: Chasing appearances or compromising your autonomy for short-term comfort is eroding real security.
challenge.zh: 追逐表面体面，或为图一时省心让渡自主权，正在悄悄侵蚀真正底气。

resource.en: You have real accomplishments you are not giving yourself credit for, and the freedom to stop performing. Dropping one costly pretense can return money and ease quickly.
resource.zh: 你有实打实的成绩，只是没给自己记上功；你也有停止表演的自由。放下一项昂贵的门面，钱和轻松都能很快回到手上。

action.en: Trim one status expense, reclaim a piece of personal independence, and verify that your comfort rests on solid numbers.
action.zh: 砍掉一笔撑场面的无效开销，收回一块个人自主权，确保你的体面建立在真实账本上。

outcome.en: Stripping away pretense brings back authentic peace of mind and steadier self-worth.
outcome.zh: 去掉虚饰之后，踏实的心安与稳固的自我价值感会重新回到你手里。

advice.en: Build real freedom behind the scenes rather than performing abundance for an audience.
advice.zh: 把功夫花在幕后真正的自由上，而不是演一场给旁人看的丰盛戏码。

hidden.en: Check what the image is costing behind the scenes, and whether guilt is stopping you from resting. There may also be loneliness that self-reliance has kept politely out of view.
hidden.zh: 查一查这副形象在幕后花了多少代价，以及是不是愧疚感让你不敢休息。也可能有一份孤单，被“我自己能行”客客气气地挡在了视线之外。

self.en: You may be presenting a more comfortable picture than you actually feel—leaning on outside approval or support, and finding it hard to enjoy what you have without guilt.
self.zh: 你展示出来的样子可能比真实感受更舒坦——依赖着外界的认可或支持，也很难不带愧疚地享用自己已有的东西。

other.en: Image and status seem to matter a great deal to the other person, or they may be relying heavily on another's resources; what they display is likely more polished than their real situation.
other.zh: 对方似乎很在意形象与地位，或者相当依赖别人的资源；展示出来的一面，很可能比真实处境光鲜得多。

external.en: The surroundings press you to look successful: costly social expectations, comparison with peers, or a dependence on someone else's support limit how free you really are.
external.zh: 周围的环境在推着你“看上去成功”：花费不菲的社交期待、与同辈的比较，或对他人资助的依赖，都限制着你真正的自由。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to be seen as accomplished and at ease, yet fear that without the trappings—or without someone's backing—there would be little to show and no one beside you.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望在别人眼里功成而从容，却又怕一旦没了这些行头，或没了某个人的支撑，自己就拿不出什么，身边也空无一人。

general.en: Check the gap between looking prosperous and actually feeling secure. Reclaim quiet self-reliance and drop unnecessary performance.
general.zh: 星币九逆位提醒你核对“看起来体面”与“真正有底气”之间的落差。收回安静的自立，放下多余表演。

love.en: In love, reversed Nine of Pentacles warns against financial or emotional overdependence—or staying guarded in gilded isolation.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提醒警惕经济或情绪上的过度依附，也留意是否把自己关在华丽却孤单的高墙里。

career.en: At work, beware undercharging, lifestyle creep, or trading long-term independence for a gilded cage. Rebuild your personal runway.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，警惕报低价、消费膨胀，或为了表面光鲜困在金色牢笼里。重新加厚自己的独立跑道。

health.en: Overwork disguised as ambition is robbing you of simple pleasure; schedule genuine rest without needing to earn it first.
health.zh: 伪装成上进心的过度劳累正在夺走生活滋味；无需先拿成绩交换，现在就给自己安排真正休整。

spirituality.en: True worth cannot be bought or performed; reconnect with the quiet sufficiency already inside you.
spirituality.zh: 真正的自我价值既无法靠昂贵标签买来，也不必靠精致人设演给别人看；安静回连你内在原本就具足的沉静底气与定力。

archetypeEssence.en: Enduring legacy—abundance that outlives a single season and shelters generations under one roof.
archetypeEssence.zh: 绵延传承的家业与丰盛——超越一时得失、足以庇护几代人的长久根基。

en: Silver-haired elder in embroidered robes seated peacefully at the estate gateway
Two loyal white hounds resting affectionately beside the elder's knees
Younger couple and child standing together beneath a carved stone family archway
Ten golden pentacles arranged in the sacred Tree-of-Life constellation across the foreground
zh: 身着绣袍、安详端坐于庄园门廊下的银发长者
依偎在长者膝畔的两只忠实白犬
立于雕花石拱门下相伴交谈的年轻伴侣与孩童
按生命之树星图排布于画面前景的十枚古金星币

en: Luminous stone family courtyard archway bathed in warm parchment-gold and sunlit-ivory lantern light
Wise silver-haired elder in emerald-and-gold brocade seated with two calm white hounds beside a younger couple and child
Exactly ten gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coins arranged cleanly in the symmetrical Tree-of-Life constellation spanning the archway
Deep midnight-indigo twilight sky and carved Art Nouveau botanical stonework framing generational warmth
zh: 沐浴在暖羊皮纸金与象牙白灯火中的宏阔石雕家族庭院拱门
身着祖母绿鎏金绣袍、携两只温顺白犬安坐的银发长者，以及拱门下相伴的年轻伴侣与孩童
以工整对称的生命之树星图阵列悬浮于拱门前的恰好十枚浮雕古金星币
深邃午夜蓝暮色与新艺术植物石雕，衬托出世代传承的温润气象

core.en: Ten of Pentacles is culmination built to last: generational wealth, home, institutional stability, and the quiet satisfaction of creating something sturdy enough to pass forward.
core.zh: 星币十代表经得起时间考验的圆满：稳固的家业、归属感、长青制度，以及把可靠根基交到下一代或后来者手中的踏实欣慰。

message.en: Think in decades, not weeks—make the decision that strengthens your long-term home, family, or enduring legacy.
message.zh: 以十年而非以周为单位思考——做出那个能夯实长远家园、家族或持久传承的选择。

foundation.en: Family roots, ancestral wisdom, established institutions, or long-term savings formed the sturdy bedrock beneath this story.
foundation.zh: 家族根基、前人积累、成熟体系或长期储蓄，为当下铺下了厚实底座。

present.en: You are standing inside a chapter of tangible permanence—home, heritage, or a mature enterprise reaching full stability.
present.zh: 你正站在切实稳固的阶段之中——居所、传承或成熟事业已步入长青格局。

challenge.en: The question is whether honoring tradition or family expectations is leaving too little room for your own fresh voice.
challenge.zh: 值得审视的是：维护传统与家族期待，是否悄悄挤压了你表达自我新意的空间？

resource.en: Generational support, trusted community, equity, or proven institutional knowledge backs you up right now.
resource.zh: 家族与社群托举、长期资产或经过验证的成熟经验，此刻都是你最可靠的后盾。

action.en: Formalize the long-term plan—estate, equity, documentation, or family agreement—so what you built stays protected.
action.zh: 把长远安排落到制度与纸面上——资产规划、股权架构、文档沉淀或家庭共识——让成果稳稳传下去。

outcome.en: If this course holds, it tends toward lasting prosperity, a secure home, and a proud legacy: abundance that shelters more than just you.
outcome.zh: 若沿此路走下去，局面倾向于长久的丰盛、安心的居所与值得骄傲的传承——这份富足庇护的不只是你自己。

advice.en: Build with permanence in mind, and honor both the elders who laid the stones and the future that walks through the arch.
advice.zh: 怀着长远之心去建造，既敬重当年铺石的前人，也为即将穿过拱门的后来者留路。

hidden.en: Look at the inheritance you may not have counted: family patterns, old agreements, or long-standing support that quietly shape this matter more than recent events do.
hidden.zh: 看看那些你可能没算进去的“家底”：家庭模式、陈年约定或长期以来的支持，它们对这件事的无声影响，也许比近来发生的事更深。

self.en: You are thinking beyond yourself—rooted, responsible, and weighing each choice by what it means for family, home, and the long term.
self.zh: 你想的不只是自己——有根基，有担当，每个选择都会掂量它对家人、对家，以及对长远意味着什么。

other.en: They come across as established and family-minded; they are likely looking for permanence and may weigh this by how it fits their long-term plans or the people they belong to.
other.zh: 对方给人的印象是根基稳固、重视家庭；多半在寻求长久，也可能会看这件事是否合乎自己的长远规划，以及能否融进自己所属的那群人。

external.en: A stable, established structure surrounds this matter—family, an institution, or long-standing wealth and custom—providing security along with its own expectations.
external.zh: 这件事被一个稳固成熟的结构包围着——家庭、机构，或积累多年的财富与规矩——它带来保障，也带着自己的一套期待。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to build something lasting that keeps the people you love secure, yet fear that settling into it means being bound by duty and other people's expectations.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望建起一份长久的东西，让所爱的人安稳无忧，却又怕一旦安顿进去，就会被责任和旁人的期待牢牢绑住。

general.en: Long-term stability, shared heritage, and lasting material fulfillment anchor this reading. Invest in what endures.
general.zh: 长远稳固的根基、可延续的共同传承与持久的现实圆满是此刻核心基调。把心力与资源投向经得起岁月沉淀的人事与结构。

love.en: In love, Ten of Pentacles speaks of deep commitment, building a home together, blending families, and a partnership sturdy enough to weather decades.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币十指向深厚承诺、共同筑家、融入彼此家庭，以及足以携手走过漫长岁月的稳固伴侣关系。

career.en: At work, this signals wealth preservation, retirement planning, real estate, family business, or creating durable systems and mentorship that outlast your tenure.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，它预示资产保值、长期规划、房产置业、家族事业，或搭建出超越个人任期的长青体系。

health.en: For wellbeing, look to lifelong longevity habits and family health history—steady preventative care protects your future self.
health.zh: 在身心管理上，着眼终生受用的长寿习惯与家族健康脉络——踏实的预防养护是对未来最好的投资。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, you are part of an unbroken lineage: gratitude for those who came before and stewardship for those who follow.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，你正身处绵延不断的传承之中：感恩前人铺路，也为后来者尽一份温柔的守护之责。

core.en: Ten of Pentacles reversed highlights strain around legacy: family disputes over money, shaky long-term plans, or outgrowing an inherited script that no longer fits.
core.zh: 星币十逆位指向传承与根基处的张力：围绕钱财家产的家庭摩擦、不够稳固的长远规划，或旧有家族剧本已不再合身。

blocked.en: Short-term thinking or unspoken family tensions are undermining long-term stability.
blocked.zh: 短视决策或未说破的家庭心结，正在动摇长远安稳。

excess.en: Clinging to outdated family rules or status expectations at the cost of genuine happiness.
excess.zh: 死守过时的家规或门面期待，牺牲了真实的生活愉悦。

internalized.en: Carrying heavy pressure to live up to an inherited legacy you never chose.
internalized.zh: 内心背负着沉重期待，勉强去接一份自己从未主动选择的剧本。

release.en: Redefining home and legacy on your own honest terms rather than repeating old patterns.
release.zh: 不再机械重复旧模式，按自己真诚的价值观重新定义“家”与“传承”。

message.en: Decide what you want to carry forward and what stops with you. Home and legacy are yours to redefine, as long as the long-term footing stays sound.
message.zh: 想清楚哪些要接着传下去，哪些到你这里为止。“家”与“传承”可以由你重新定义，只要长远的根基仍然稳当。

foundation.en: Old family tensions, an unsettled question about money or inheritance, or a role you were handed rather than chose lie at the root of this.
foundation.zh: 陈年的家庭心结、一桩没理清的钱财或继承问题，或一个被交到你手里而非你自己选的角色，是这件事的根源。

present.en: What was meant to be solid is under strain: shared money or property is a sore point, long-range plans look shaky, or family expectations no longer fit who you are.
present.zh: 本该稳固的东西正在承压：共同的钱或房产成了痛点，长远的打算显得不牢靠，或者家里的期待已经不合如今的你。

challenge.en: Conflicts over shared assets, inheritance, or conflicting generational values are creating friction.
challenge.zh: 围绕共同资产、分配或代际观念差异的分歧，正在制造现实摩擦。

resource.en: You still inherit what is worth keeping—values, skills, hard-earned lessons about money—and outgrowing the old script frees you to build a home on your own terms.
resource.zh: 值得留下的东西仍然传到了你手里——价值观、本事、关于钱的沉痛教训；而走出旧剧本，也让你可以按自己的方式去建一个家。

action.en: Put shared finances and expectations in plain writing, and separate loving your family from obeying every outdated expectation.
action.zh: 把共同财务与权责落到清晰纸面，同时分清“爱家人”与“顺从所有过时期望”的区别。

outcome.en: Clearing up financial ambiguity or stepping into your own values builds a healthier foundation going forward.
outcome.zh: 理清财务模糊地带或忠于自己的价值尺度，会为你接下来的日子搭起更健康的新地基。

advice.en: Keep what is wise from the past, renegotiate what is brittle, and protect your long-term solvency.
advice.zh: 保留前人留下的智慧，重谈已经脆弱失灵的旧约，同时牢牢护住你的长远偿付力。

hidden.en: Check for what the family does not discuss: an unspoken resentment, an unclear will or debt, or the weight of an expectation you never agreed to carry.
hidden.zh: 查一查家里避而不谈的那些事：一份没说出口的怨气，一份不清不楚的遗嘱或债务，或一个你从未答应过却一直背着的期待。

self.en: You are torn between loyalty and your own path—feeling the pull of what you were expected to become while sensing it no longer fits you.
self.zh: 你现在被忠诚与自己的路两头拉扯——既感到“本该成为那样的人”的牵引，又察觉那副样子已经不再合身。

other.en: The other party appears bound up with family obligations or money pressures; they may be defending tradition and status, or struggling to step out from under them.
other.zh: 对方看起来被家庭责任或经济压力缠着；可能在维护传统与门面，也可能正吃力地想从这些东西底下走出来。

external.en: The structures meant to provide stability are unsettled—family conflict, a disputed estate, an institution in decline—and their problems are landing on you.
external.zh: 本该提供安稳的结构自身并不安稳——家庭矛盾、有争议的家产、走下坡路的机构——它们的问题正落到你头上。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes to make peace with your family and still live by your own values; another part fears that choosing your own way means losing your place, your support, or their approval.
hopes_fears.zh: 你既希望与家人和解，又希望照自己的价值观生活；同时也怕走自己的路，就意味着失去位置、失去支持，或失去家人的认可。

general.en: Examine where long-term foundations have cracks—financial overextension, family friction, or clinging to an inherited mold you have outgrown.
general.zh: 星币十逆位提醒你检查长远地基上的裂缝：是否存在财务透支、家庭摩擦，或仍硬塞在早已不合身的旧框架里？

love.en: In love, reversed Ten of Pentacles flags tension with in-laws, mismatched visions of home and money, or fear of deep long-term commitment.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提示与双方家庭的磨合压力、对居所与金钱观的分歧，或对长久承诺的隐隐退缩。

career.en: At work, beware unstable partnerships, neglected succession planning, or chasing quick wins that jeopardize long-term reputation.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，警惕不稳固的合伙架构、疏于交接的体系风险，或为了短线收益透支长期口碑。

health.en: Don't ignore recurring hereditary patterns or long-term wear and tear; address foundational care now.
health.zh: 别再忽视家族遗传倾向、环境因素或日积月累的慢性损耗；趁现在还有充分余地，把基础体检与长期养护安排提上日程。

spirituality.en: Healing ancestral patterns means honoring your roots without letting old fears dictate your future.
spirituality.zh: 疗愈代际流传下来的惯性模式，意味着既能敬重先辈与来路的馈赠，又不再让上一代的匮乏恐惧替你决定今天的未来。

promptSpec.suitAccent: verdant emerald-verdigris, warm parchment ochre, embossed antique gold pentacle coins, sunlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: Beneath a grand, warmly lantern-lit Belle Epoque stone courtyard archway adorned with carved botanical vines, a serene silver-haired elder in rich emerald-and-gold brocade robes sits peacefully on the right with TWO gentle white hounds resting beside them, while a younger couple and a child stand together in warm conversation beneath the luminous arch. Suspended cleanly across the foreground in the unmistakable symmetrical Tree-of-Life constellation are EXACTLY TEN gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coins (1 at top crown, 2 upper flanking, 2 mid-upper flanking, 1 center heart, 2 mid-lower flanking, 1 lower center, 1 bottom base) so every single coin of the TEN is bright, cleanly separated, and countable. Warm parchment-ochre courtyard glow contrasts richly with the deep midnight-indigo twilight sky beyond the estate towers.

requiredObjects.object: seated silver-haired elder with two white hounds
younger family couple and child under stone arch
embossed golden pentacle coins arranged in the 10-node Tree-of-Life constellation

promptSpec.compositionNote: Architectural stone archway framing generational figures, anchored by EXACTLY TEN bright gold pentacles in the unmistakable Tree-of-Life geometric constellation—reads crisply even at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Earnest apprenticeship—holding a bright new skill or practical dream with absorbed, unhurried curiosity.
archetypeEssence.zh: 沉静笃实的求学初心——双手捧着崭新的技艺或务实梦想，全神贯注地踏出第一步。

en: Attentive youth standing in a flowering meadow gazing closely at a raised pentacle
Single golden pentacle cradled lightly between both hands as if studying its craft
Freshly plowed fields and budding trees stretching across the fertile plain
Distant blue mountain range promising a long, rewarding climb of mastery
zh: 立于繁花草甸之上、全神贯注凝望手中星币的年轻学徒
双手轻捧于胸前细细端详的一枚古金星币
眼前新翻的沃土田垄与初绽新绿的树林
远方绵延的群山，预示值得稳步攀登的成长之路

en: Earnest Belle Epoque apprentice in verdant emerald tunic, ochre neckerchief, and soft velvet cap standing in a blooming meadow
Exactly one gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coin held delicately between both raised hands at eye level
Luminous wildflowers, plowed twilight-and-dawn garden rows, and distant midnight-indigo hills
Warm sunlit-ivory glow illuminating the youth's absorbed face, open hands, and the single golden pentacle
zh: 身着祖母绿短衫、赭金领巾与软绒帽，立于繁花草甸中的专注美好年代学徒
双手轻捧至眉眼间细细研读的恰好一枚浮雕古金星币
脚畔盛放的野花、晨光田垄与远方午夜蓝山峦
暖象牙白晨光照亮少年专注的眉眼、双手与这枚唯一星币

core.en: Page of Pentacles brings diligent curiosity: studying a new craft, testing a practical opportunity, or receiving welcome tangible news that rewards patience and real homework.
core.zh: 星币侍从带来踏实的好奇心：潜心学习一门新技能、认真试水一个务实机会，或迎来值得用心跟进的好消息。

message.en: Approach this as a dedicated student—read the details, practice the basics, and turn curiosity into a concrete skill.
message.zh: 以认真学徒的心态面对眼前的事——啃透细节、练好基本功，把好奇变成实打实的本事。

foundation.en: A fresh course, early prototype, scholarship, or modest practical goal sparked this path.
foundation.zh: 一门新课程、早期雏形、资助机会或一个具体小目标，开启了这段旅程。

present.en: You are in a fertile learning phase; stay humble, ask sharp questions, and let tangible practice guide you.
present.zh: 你正处在吸收力极强的成长期；保持谦逊、多问务实问题，用动手实践带动理解。

challenge.en: Watch for eternal preparation mode: studying the coin so long that you forget to put it into circulation.
challenge.zh: 当心一直停在准备阶段：盯着星币研究太久，却忘了让它真正流通起来。

resource.en: Willingness to learn from scratch and pay close attention to small details is your quiet superpower right now.
resource.zh: 愿意从零学起且肯在细节上下功夫，是你此刻最稳妥的加分项。

action.en: Enroll, build the small sample, draft the budget, or send the earnest inquiry today.
action.zh: 今天就报下那门课、做出小样、列出预算，或发出那封诚恳务实的联络信。

outcome.en: With steady follow-through, a promising offer, an accepted application, or a solid new capability is likely to take root.
outcome.zh: 只要踏实跟进，一份有潜力的邀约、一次通过的申请或一项扎实的新技能，很可能就此扎下根来。

advice.en: Stay curious, keep your promises small and kept, and respect the early steps of mastery.
advice.zh: 保持求知欲，许下小而必兑现的承诺，认真走好成长的头几步。

hidden.en: A small opening may be easy to overlook because it looks so modest—a course, a trial task, a piece of practical news. Check what you have been dismissing as minor.
hidden.zh: 有个小机会可能因为太不起眼而被忽略——一门课、一项试用任务、一条实用的消息。看看有什么被你当成小事随手放过了。

self.en: You show up as a willing beginner—curious, conscientious, and ready to learn the basics properly instead of pretending to know more than you do.
self.zh: 你是以一个甘当新手的姿态出现的——有好奇心，做事认真，愿意老老实实把基础学扎实，而不是不懂装懂。

other.en: The other person seems sincere and studious, though still new to this; they are likely to move carefully, ask practical questions, and need time before committing fully.
other.zh: 对方显得诚恳又好学，只是在这方面还是新手；多半会小心行事、问些实际的问题，需要一段时间才能完全投入。

external.en: The setting offers room to learn: an entry-level opening, a study or training opportunity, or practical news on its way, in an environment patient with beginners.
external.zh: 这个环境留有学习的余地：一个入门级的机会、一次进修或培训，或一条正在路上的实用消息，而且周围对新手还算有耐心。

hopes_fears.en: You hope this small start will grow into real competence and a livelihood, yet fear being exposed as a beginner or finding the climb far longer than you expected.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望这个小小的起步能长成真本事和一份营生，却又怕被人看出还是个新手，或发现这段爬坡路比预想的长得多。

general.en: Practical learning and earnest first steps open real doors. Treat this moment as fertile training ground.
general.zh: 务实谦逊的学习态度与诚恳扎实的起步正为你悄悄打开现实大门。把当下这一步当作最肥沃的练兵场，边做边攒硬本领。

love.en: In love, Page of Pentacles shows sincere, grounded affection—learning what makes a partner feel cared for through thoughtful small actions rather than drama.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币侍从体现为真诚笨拙却极可靠的用心——不靠花哨戏码，而是认真了解并记住让对方安心的小细节。

career.en: At work or study, this is a classic card of internships, certifications, new tools, grants, or pitching a well-researched pilot project.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，它常对应进修考证、掌握新工具、申请资助或提交一份做足功课的试点方案。

health.en: For wellbeing, educate yourself on one foundational habit—sleep hygiene, form, or nutrition—and test it patiently for two weeks.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，认真弄懂一个基础原则（睡眠节律、动作规范或营养搭配），先踏实试行两周。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, awe shows up in close attention: studying the living world with patience and humility.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的敬畏往往藏在细致耐心的专注里：带着初学者的谦卑去真实观察、亲手练习并感受眼前具体世界。

core.en: Page of Pentacles reversed points to procrastination, scattered focus, or daydreaming about results while dodging the unglamorous homework.
core.zh: 星币侍从逆位指向拖延观望、注意力分散，或憧憬成果却迟迟不肯动手做枯燥的基础功课。

blocked.en: Overthinking the first step or fearing beginner mistakes keeps the plan stuck on paper.
blocked.zh: 把第一步想得太复杂，或怕犯新手错误，让计划一直停在纸面上。

excess.en: Hoarding courses, books, and tools without actually finishing or applying one.
excess.zh: 囤了一堆课程、资料与工具，却没有真正学完并落地用起来。

internalized.en: Feeling behind compared to peers and losing confidence before you give yourself time to learn.
internalized.zh: 拿自己和别人横向比较而暗自气馁，还没给自己留出成长时间就先打了退堂鼓。

release.en: Dropping a goal you only pursued out of obligation so your energy returns to genuine curiosity.
release.zh: 放下那些只是为了应付期待才硬啃的目标，把精力还给真正让你眼睛发亮的事。

message.en: Trade one hour of planning for one hour of doing. The plan is fine; what is missing is the plain, repeated practice that makes it real.
message.zh: 拿一个小时的规划，去换一个小时的动手。计划本身没问题，缺的是那份平平常常、反复去做的练习，它才能让计划成真。

foundation.en: A good intention was never followed through, or a course of study was started and dropped, and that unfinished beginning is still waiting in the background.
foundation.zh: 一个不错的打算始终没有落实，或一段学习开了头又半途搁下；那个没做完的开端，至今还在背后等着。

present.en: Ideas are plentiful and progress is thin: attention keeps drifting, materials pile up unused, and the basic groundwork keeps getting put off until tomorrow.
present.zh: 想法很多，进展却很少：注意力总在飘，资料越堆越多却没用上，最基础的功课一天天往后推。

challenge.en: Lack of follow-through, distraction, or skipping basic preparation is stalling real progress.
challenge.zh: 缺乏持续跟进、分心走神或跳过基础准备，正在卡住实质进展。

resource.en: Your curiosity is intact, and you already own more tools and knowledge than you have used. Letting go of a goal that was never really yours frees energy for one that is.
resource.zh: 你的好奇心还在，手里的工具和知识也比用上的多。放下一个本就不属于你的目标，力气才能腾给真正属于你的那一个。

action.en: Shrink the task to one 25-minute concrete step today and finish it before reading another tutorial.
action.zh: 把任务缩成今天就能做完的25分钟具体小步，先动手做完再去看下一篇教程。

outcome.en: Momentum returns the moment you trade passive planning for one finished, imperfect attempt.
outcome.zh: 只要把空想换成一次虽不完美但真正完成的尝试，局面就会立刻松动。

advice.en: Stop waiting to feel ready; competence is built by doing the work badly once and then better.
advice.zh: 别等完全准备好才开始；本事都是在先笨拙做一次、再越做越顺里长出来的。

hidden.en: Check whether fear of looking like a beginner is what keeps the first step from happening, and whether comparing yourself with others has quietly drained your confidence.
hidden.zh: 看看是不是怕自己显得像个新手，才让第一步迟迟迈不出去；又是否因为总和别人比较，自信已被悄悄耗掉。

self.en: You are playing the eternal preparer—interested and well-meaning, yet distracted, measuring yourself against others, and holding back until conditions feel perfect.
self.zh: 你现在像个永远在准备的人——有兴趣，也有诚意，却容易分心，总拿自己和别人比，非要等条件万全才肯开始。

other.en: Good intentions seem to outrun follow-through on their side—enthusiastic in words, slow in practice, and likely not yet ready to do the unglamorous part.
other.zh: 对方的心意似乎跑在了行动前面——嘴上很起劲，落到实处却慢，很可能还没准备好去做那些不出彩的苦功夫。

external.en: Conditions are not doing your focus any favors: too many options and distractions, unclear instructions, or an opportunity that keeps getting postponed by others.
external.zh: 外部条件并不利于你专心：选择和干扰太多，指引含糊不清，或者某个机会一再被别人往后推。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to become genuinely good at this someday, yet fear that starting for real will show you are behind everyone else—so the dream stays safer than the attempt.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望有一天能把这件事真正做好，却又怕一旦动真格，就会显出自己落后于所有人——于是做梦显得比动手更安全。

general.en: Close the gap between good intentions and actual practice. Pick one concrete task and see it through.
general.zh: 星币侍从逆位提醒你补上“想得好”和“真去做”之间的断层。挑一件具体小事，亲手做完它。

love.en: In love, reversed Page of Pentacles flags inconsistent effort, broken small promises, or reluctance to grow up into steady reliability.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提示忽冷忽热的投入、小承诺频频落空，或不愿承担起稳定可靠的日常责任。

career.en: At work, watch for missed details, half-finished learning, or procrastination on an important application. Build a simple checklist and execute.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，警惕粗心漏项、浅尝辄止或一再拖延关键申请。列张极简清单，逐项落地。

health.en: Starting and quitting routines every Monday drains morale; lower the bar until daily consistency feels easy.
health.zh: 每周一热血立下严苛目标、周三就放弃最消耗自我信任；把锻炼和作息门槛降到每天即使疲惫也能轻松做到的微小程度。

spirituality.en: Notice where collecting spiritual concepts replaces actually living them in ordinary moments.
spirituality.zh: 坦诚觉察自己是否把不断收藏灵性概念、买书听课当成了成长本身，却忘了在最平凡的日常小事里真正践行哪怕一条洞见。

promptSpec.suitAccent: verdant emerald-verdigris, warm parchment ochre, embossed antique gold pentacle coins, sunlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: Standing upright in a lush, sunlit-and-moonlit Art Nouveau wildflower meadow, an earnest Belle Epoque youth in a tailored emerald-verdigris tunic, warm parchment-ochre scarf, and soft velvet cap gazes with absorbed wonder at EXACTLY ONE gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coin cradled delicately between both raised hands at chest-to-eye level. Freshly plowed fertile earth rows, blooming ivory meadow flowers, and slender emerald saplings stretch behind the figure toward distant misty midnight-indigo hills touched by golden dawn light. High-key sunlit-ivory illumination makes the apprentice's focused profile, open hands, and the single glowing golden pentacle read with effortless clarity.

requiredObjects.object: standing apprentice youth in meadow
embossed golden pentacle coin held between both hands

promptSpec.compositionNote: Clean vertical standing silhouette holding EXACTLY ONE bright gold pentacle coin aloft against open sky—unmistakable attentive learner pose at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Unshakeable reliability—the steady craftsman of the long haul who finishes every furrow without fanfare.
archetypeEssence.zh: 稳如磐石的可靠执行——不慕虚名、一步一印，把漫长田垄踏踏实实耕到尽头。

en: Armored knight seated calmly atop a heavy, sturdy black draft horse
Single golden pentacle held steadily forward in the knight's right hand
Sprigs of green leaves adorning helmet and horse harness
Broad, freshly plowed dark fields stretching patiently toward the horizon
zh: 稳坐于敦实健壮黑马之上的披甲骑士
右手平稳托举于身前的一枚古金星币
头盔与马具上点缀的翠绿枝叶
眼前开阔规整、等待深耕的宽广田野

en: Steadfast Belle Epoque knight in burnished bronze-and-emerald plate armor mounted on a powerful, stationary dark charger
Exactly one gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coin held level and steady in the knight's gauntleted right hand
Verdant oak-leaf plumes crowning the helmet and bridle, overlooking neat plowed twilight fields
Warm parchment-gold rim-light carving out horse, armor, and single pentacle against deep midnight-indigo sky
zh: 身披古铜祖母绿雕花板甲、稳坐于沉稳黑骏马上的美好年代骑士
右手护手稳稳托举于身前的恰好一枚浮雕古金星币
头盔与马缰上点缀的翠绿橡叶，眼前是整齐绵延的暮色耕田
暖羊皮纸金轮廓光在深邃午夜蓝天幕下清晰勾勒战马、铠甲与这枚唯一星币

core.en: Knight of Pentacles is methodical follow-through: showing up on time, respecting process, and grinding out durable results long after flashier players have wandered off.
core.zh: 星币骑士代表极度可靠的稳步推进：守时守信、尊重流程，在爱凑热闹的人早已散场之后，依然一步一印把成果做扎实。

message.en: Choose consistency over speed: a boring, repeatable system executed daily is what tends to win a race like this.
message.zh: 选择稳定而非求快——一套看似平淡却每天照做不误的系统，往往才是赢下这种长跑的关键。

foundation.en: Dependable routines, conservative planning, and patient persistence built the solid traction you have today.
foundation.zh: 可靠的日常节律、稳健规划与不急不躁的坚持，为你积累了今天的扎实进展。

present.en: Progress may look slow from close up, yet every step is locking into place permanently; keep the pace steady.
present.zh: 近看或许觉得走得慢，但每一步都在牢牢夯实地基；稳住这个配速别乱。

challenge.en: Excessive caution or a perfectionist routine can cause you to miss an opening that calls for a nimble move.
challenge.zh: 过度求稳或死守力求完美的既定流程，可能让你错过一个需要灵巧出手的窗口。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is rock-solid dependability—when you give your word, people know the job will actually get done.
resource.zh: 你最强的资产是坚如磐石的可靠——只要你开口答应，大家就知道这件事真的会办成。

action.en: Map the checklist, honor the schedule, and complete the unglamorous maintenance step everyone else avoids.
action.zh: 按清单逐项推进，守住时间表，把别人都嫌枯燥的那道基础工序踏实做完。

outcome.en: If the pace holds, reliable and lasting success is likely to land on schedule: earned trust, steady income, and a finished work built to endure.
outcome.zh: 只要保持这个配速，稳妥长久的成果很可能按期兑现——挣来的信任、稳定的收入，以及一件真正耐用的成品。

advice.en: Keep all four hooves on the ground; slow and thorough outlasts fast and sloppy every time.
advice.zh: 四蹄踏实踩在地面上；慢而透彻，永远比快而潦草走得更远。

hidden.en: Check who is quietly doing the routine work that keeps this going—possibly you—and whether that dependability has started to be taken for granted.
hidden.zh: 看看是谁在默默做着让这件事维持运转的日常工作——也许就是你——以及这份可靠是否已开始被当成理所当然。

self.en: You are the dependable one—patient, thorough, and prepared to do the dull parts properly, even if that makes you slower than everyone else.
self.zh: 你是那个靠得住的人——有耐心，做事周全，枯燥的部分也肯认真做好，哪怕因此比别人都慢一些。

other.en: The other person appears steady and serious but slow to move; they are likely to act only once they are sure, and to show commitment through deeds rather than declarations.
other.zh: 对方看起来稳重认真，只是行动偏慢；多半要等心里有数了才出手，也更习惯用行动而不是宣言来表明投入。

external.en: The pace around you is slow and procedural: things advance through routine, proper channels, and long timelines, and the situation cannot be hurried from outside.
external.zh: 周围的节奏缓慢而讲程序：事情靠例行流程、正规渠道与漫长的周期往前推，从外部是催不动的。

hopes_fears.en: You hope patient, honest effort will be enough to get you there, yet fear that while you plod carefully forward, life and faster people are passing you by.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望凭着耐心和老老实实的努力就足以抵达，却又怕自己小心翼翼一步步往前挪的时候，生活和更快的人已从身边越过。

general.en: Patience, routine, and methodical craftsmanship carry the day. Trust steady increments over dramatic leaps.
general.zh: 沉稳的耐心、清晰的秩序与按部就班的扎实功夫将决定最终胜负。相信日积月累的稳步推进，远胜于一时兴起的戏剧豪赌。

love.en: In love, Knight of Pentacles is quiet devotion—loyal, protective, and proven through consistent deeds rather than poetic speeches.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币骑士是沉稳寡言却极长情的守护——不靠甜言蜜语，全靠日复一日的兑现与担当。

career.en: At work, this is operational excellence: hitting milestones, maintaining clean systems, and earning promotion through undeniable reliability.
career.zh: 在职场上，这是教科书级的执行力：按期交付、维护整洁系统，靠无可挑剔的靠谱赢得重任。

health.en: For wellbeing, steady daily fundamentals—walking, strength training, regular sleep—deliver quiet, unmistakable resilience.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，雷打不动的基础节奏（散步、力量训练、规律作息）会养出沉稳耐造的体能。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, faithfulness in small daily commitments is deeper than occasional peak experiences.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，在日复一日的平凡生活里稳稳守住微小的诚实、信诺与自律，远比追逐偶发炫目的高峰体验更有长久分量。

core.en: Knight of Pentacles reversed points to stubborn stagnation, joyless routine, or getting stuck in a rut while refusing to adapt.
core.zh: 星币骑士逆位指向固执停滞、枯燥乏味的惯性泥潭，或死守旧法不肯变通。

blocked.en: Rigidity or fear of deviation keeps a stalled plan frozen in place.
blocked.zh: 过于刻板或害怕偏离计划，让原本卡住的事彻底动弹不得。

excess.en: Obsessive perfectionism or workaholic grinding that drains all warmth and spontaneity.
excess.zh: 偏执的完美主义或机械加班，把生活里的温度与灵气榨得一干二净。

internalized.en: Quiet boredom and restlessness hidden beneath a dutiful, unchanging exterior.
internalized.zh: 在尽职尽责、一成不变的外表下，内心其实早已感到沉闷与焦躁。

release.en: Breaking out of an outdated routine to invite fresh air and smarter methods.
release.zh: 主动打破过时的陈旧惯性，让新鲜空气与更聪明的方法流进来。

message.en: Keep the goal and question the routine. If the same steps have stopped producing movement, repeating them harder is habit, not diligence.
message.zh: 目标留着，惯例要拿出来问一问。如果同样的步骤已带不来进展，再加倍重复就只是习惯，而不是勤奋。

foundation.en: A routine that once served you well was kept long past its usefulness, and loyalty to the old way of doing things is how the present standstill took hold.
foundation.zh: 一套曾经很管用的惯例，被沿用到早已失效；正是对老办法的这份忠诚，让如今的停滞扎下了根。

present.en: Things have ground to a halt or a dull loop: the same tasks, the same pace, little progress and less enthusiasm, with change being resisted more than considered.
present.zh: 事情要么停住了，要么陷进了沉闷的循环：同样的任务，同样的节奏，进展不多，热情更少，对改变的抗拒也多过考虑。

challenge.en: Stubbornness, tunnel vision, or burnout from monotonous grind is slowing everything down.
challenge.zh: 固执己见、视野变窄或单调重复带来的倦怠，正在拖慢整体节奏。

resource.en: Your stamina and sense of duty are still assets once they are pointed somewhere useful. The restlessness you feel is also worth trusting—it shows where fresh air is needed.
resource.zh: 你的耐力和责任心，只要用对地方，依然是本钱。那份坐不住的感觉也值得信任——它指出了哪里需要透透气。

action.en: Change one rigid habit this week, listen to an outside suggestion, and automate or drop a tedious bottleneck.
action.zh: 这周主动改掉一条僵化习惯，听取一个外部建议，把一个拖后腿的繁琐环节交给自动化，或干脆砍掉。

outcome.en: Loosening the reins restores momentum and turns dutiful drudgery back into purposeful progress.
outcome.zh: 适当松一松缰绳后，停滞感会化开，机械苦干也会重新变成有方向的推进。

advice.en: Reliability is a virtue, not a prison—stay steady in purpose while staying flexible in method.
advice.zh: 靠谱是美德而非牢笼——守住大方向的稳，同时放开方法上的活。

hidden.en: Look beneath the dutiful surface for boredom or weariness that has not been admitted, and ask whether fear of getting it wrong is what keeps every step the same.
hidden.zh: 往尽职尽责的表面底下看一看，是否有没被承认的厌倦或疲惫；也问问自己，是不是怕出错，才让每一步都一成不变。

self.en: You are dutiful but stuck—doing what you have always done, wary of any deviation, and more tired and bored than you are letting on.
self.zh: 你现在尽责却停滞——照着一贯的做法行事，对任何偏离都心存戒备，实际上比表现出来的更累、也更闷。

other.en: They seem set in their ways and slow to respond; they may be carrying on out of duty alone, and are unlikely to change course quickly even when asked.
other.zh: 对方似乎习惯已定、反应也慢；可能只是出于责任在继续做下去，即便有人提出来，也不太会很快改变方向。

external.en: The environment is heavy with inertia—rigid procedures, slow-moving institutions, or dull obligations—and it rewards compliance more than initiative.
external.zh: 周围充满惯性——僵硬的流程、行动迟缓的机构，或乏味的义务——它奖励的是照办，而不是主动。

hopes_fears.en: A change that brings some life back into the work is what you hope for, yet you fear that leaving the familiar track means losing the one thing you are known for: being reliable.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼的是来一点变化，让手头的事重新有些生气；怕的是离开熟悉的轨道，就丢掉了自己最为人称道的那一点：可靠。

general.en: Check where healthy persistence has hardened into stubbornness or boredom. Refresh the method without abandoning the goal.
general.zh: 星币骑士逆位提醒你留意：原本可贵的坚持，是否已硬化成固执或麻木？守住目标，但该换换走法了。

love.en: In love, reversed Knight of Pentacles flags emotional predictability turning stale, or digging heels in during a disagreement.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提示日复一日的过度平淡让关系失去新鲜活力，或在出现分歧时双方都固执己见、死守旧规而不肯灵活松动。

career.en: At work, watch for clinging to obsolete processes, micromanaging details, or feeling trapped in a dead-end routine. Propose a smarter workflow.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕抱残守缺、死抠细枝末节，或困在毫无新意的旧轨道里。主动提出更高效的流程迭代。

health.en: Physical stiffness or sluggishness mirrors rigid habits; introduce gentle variety in movement and rest.
health.zh: 身体的僵硬、滞重或提不起劲往往直接呼应着过于刻板单一的作息；给日常运动、拉伸与休养节奏加入一点轻盈新鲜的变化。

spirituality.en: Step outside the familiar furrow; wonder returns when you stop demanding that every day look identical.
spirituality.zh: 试着主动走出那条早已走惯的思维旧田垄；当你不再执着于要求每一天都按部就班一模一样，鲜活敏锐的觉知便会回来。

promptSpec.compositionNote: Grounded, rock-solid equestrian profile paused above plowed fields, with EXACTLY ONE bright gold pentacle held clearly at chest height—distinctly calm and planted at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Warm, capable stewardship—turning resources, home, and care into a flourishing sanctuary where people actually thrive.
archetypeEssence.zh: 温润而能干的丰盛守护——把资源、居所与照料经营成让人真正安心生长的沃土。

en: Compassionate Queen seated on a stone throne carved with fruit, flowers, and cherubs
Single golden pentacle cradled warmly in both hands on her lap
Lush blooming rose bower and verdant garden surrounding her seat
Alert little hare darting beside her feet symbolizing fertility and earthy vitality
zh: 端坐于雕满花果纹饰石座之上的温厚王后
双手温热捧护于膝间的一枚古金星币
环绕宝座盛放的玫瑰花廊与繁茂花园
跃于脚畔的小野兔，象征蓬勃生机与大地丰饶

en: Warm, composed Belle Epoque Queen in deep emerald-verdigris velvet and sunlit-ivory silk gown seated on a vine-carved stone throne
Exactly one gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coin cradled tenderly in both hands at her lap
Blooming crimson-and-ivory rose arch, overflowing garden foliage, and one alert ivory-brown hare poised beside her hem
Luminous golden-hour light illuminating her serene face, caring hands, and the single golden pentacle against midnight-indigo garden depth
zh: 身着深祖母绿天鹅绒与象牙白丝绸长裙、端坐于藤蔓雕花石座上的温润美好年代王后
双手稳稳捧护于膝前的恰好一枚浮雕古金星币
盛放的玫瑰花拱、繁茂绿植，以及停驻在她裙裾畔的一只灵动野兔
暖金晨昏光晕照亮她从容的眉眼、双手与这枚唯一星币，映衬深邃午夜蓝花园影调

core.en: Queen of Pentacles unites practical competence with genuine warmth: managing money, home, and people so well that everyone around her feels both cared for and grounded.
core.zh: 星币王后将干练务实与真挚温厚融为一体：把财务、生活与人情打理得井井有条，让身处她照拂之下的人既踏实又被滋养。

message.en: Lead with practical care—tend the real-world details, nourish yourself first, and create an environment where good work can flourish.
message.zh: 用落在实处的照料去引领局面——理顺现实细节、先把自己养好，再搭出让好事情自然生长的环境。

foundation.en: Resourceful management, warm hospitality, or steady nurturing built the safe base supporting this situation.
foundation.zh: 精明温和的统筹、悉心照料或踏实持家，为你打下了眼下这份安心底气。

present.en: You have the capacity to balance ambition with comfort—stay grounded, generous, and quietly efficient.
present.zh: 你正具备兼顾进取与舒适的游刃能量——保持踏实、宽厚与不动声色的高效。

challenge.en: Notice whether taking care of everyone's practical needs is quietly leaving your own cup last in line.
challenge.zh: 留意一下：替所有人打理现实需求，是否悄悄把你自己的需要排到了最后？

resource.en: Your strongest asset is earthy wisdom: knowing how to turn modest ingredients into lasting comfort, loyalty, and real value.
resource.zh: 你最强的资本是接地气的智慧：懂得把寻常资源经营成长久的体面、信赖与真实价值。

action.en: Upgrade one practical system—home, budget, meal prep, or team workflow—so daily life feels calmer and more abundant.
action.zh: 升级一套日常实务系统（居所、预算、饮食或团队流程），让每天的运转更从容丰裕。

outcome.en: Tended this way, things lean toward warm prosperity, trusted stability, and a thriving home or enterprise: abundance you can actually feel.
outcome.zh: 这样经营下去，局面倾向于温润的富足、令人信赖的安稳，以及兴旺的家或事业——一种真正摸得着的丰盛。

advice.en: Be generous without losing your footing; practical kindness is one of the strongest forms of leadership.
advice.zh: 慷慨而不失分寸；落在实处的善意，本身就是最具凝聚力的领导力。

hidden.en: Notice the unseen labor that keeps everything comfortable—the planning, budgeting, and care nobody remarks on—and check who is doing it and what they need in return.
hidden.zh: 留意那些让一切舒舒服服运转、却没人看见的操持——筹划、算账、照料，从没人提起——再看看是谁在做，又需要什么回报。

self.en: You bring warmth and competence—the person who makes things work in practice, looks after people's real needs, and stays calm about money and logistics.
self.zh: 你带来的是温暖与能干——是那个让事情落到实处的人，照顾得到大家的真实需要，面对钱和琐事也不慌不忙。

other.en: Generous, practical, and steady is the impression the other person gives; they are likely to show care through tangible help—a meal, a favor, sound advice—more than through words.
other.zh: 对方给人的感觉是慷慨、务实又稳当；表达关心的方式，多半是实在的帮助——一顿饭、一次援手、一句中肯的建议——而不是言语。

external.en: You are in a supportive, well-resourced setting: a comfortable home base, sensible people around you, and enough material security to let things grow at a healthy pace.
external.zh: 你身处一个有支持、有资源的环境：安稳舒适的大本营，身边是明白事理的人，物质上的保障也足以让事情按健康的节奏生长。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to provide a warm, abundant home for the people you love, yet fear that the comfort you built could be lost, or that your generosity will simply be expected rather than appreciated.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望为所爱的人撑起一个温暖富足的家，却又怕这份亲手经营的安稳有朝一日会失去，或怕自己的付出只被当作应该，而不是被珍惜。

general.en: Grounded abundance and capable care guide this moment. Tend both material order and human warmth with equal skill.
general.zh: 踏实丰盛的现实底气与能干温厚的照料力是此刻主线。既守住清晰务实的现实秩序，又保有人情温度，局面自然日渐兴旺。

love.en: In love, Queen of Pentacles brings sensual comfort, fierce loyalty, and love shown through home-cooked warmth, reliability, and practical support.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币王后带来烟火气十足的踏实宠爱、深厚忠诚，以及落在衣食住行与日常兜底里的真情。

career.en: At work, this is savvy operations, budget stewardship, ethical entrepreneurship, and mentoring a team so both profit and morale stay healthy.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，她代表精明稳健的运营统筹、预算掌舵与有温度的带队方式，让业绩与人心双双健康。

health.en: For wellbeing, nourish your body like a treasured garden—wholesome food, sensory comfort, nature, and unhurried rest.
health.zh: 在身心养护上，像照料珍贵花园一样对待身体——温热踏实的饮食、亲近自然与从容休养最能回血。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, earth itself is the altar: hospitality, cooking, gardening, and caring for living things are sacred acts.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，大地本身即是圣坛：款待、烹茶、植花与照料生命，都是最质朴深厚的修行。

core.en: Queen of Pentacles reversed points to caretaker burnout, work-life imbalance, or smothering control disguised as 'just helping.'
core.zh: 星币王后逆位指向照料者透支、工作与生活失衡，或打着“为你好”旗号的过度操心与控制。

blocked.en: Neglecting your own rest, finances, or home order while putting out everyone else's fires.
blocked.zh: 忙着替别人灭火，却把自己的休息、财务与生活秩序晾在了一边。

excess.en: Over-functioning, hovering, or worrying obsessively about money and comfort.
excess.zh: 事必躬亲地大包大揽，或围绕钱财与安稳陷入停不下来的焦虑。

internalized.en: Feeling resentful that nobody takes care of you the way you take care of them.
internalized.zh: 心里暗自委屈：你把大家照顾得那么周全，却没人同样来照料你。

release.en: Stepping back from over-caretaking so you can replenish your own garden first.
release.zh: 主动从过度操心中退一步，先把自己的花园重新浇灌丰盈。

message.en: Put yourself back on the list of people you look after. Care that runs you into the ground, or that leaves others no room to manage, is not serving anyone.
message.zh: 把自己重新写回你要照顾的名单里。把你累垮的照料，或不给别人留一点自理余地的照料，对谁都没有好处。

foundation.en: Years of being the one who handles everything—often at the expense of your own rest, money, or space—built the depletion you are dealing with now.
foundation.zh: 多年来你一直是那个包揽一切的人，常常以自己的休息、钱或空间为代价；如今的透支，正是这样一点点累积出来的。

present.en: The balance between giving and replenishing has tipped: home, work, and other people's needs are crowding out your own, and warmth is turning into worry or fussing.
present.zh: 付出与补给之间的平衡已经倾斜：家务、工作和别人的需要挤占了你自己的需要，原本的温暖也渐渐变成了担忧或唠叨。

challenge.en: Self-neglect or trying to manage everyone else's life is draining your warmth and clarity.
challenge.zh: 忽略自我养护或忍不住替别人操盘生活，正在快速耗干你的温润与清明。

resource.en: Your practical gifts have not gone anywhere; they are simply pointed outward. Turned toward your own home, budget, and body, the same skills can restore you quickly.
resource.zh: 你打理生活的本领一点没丢，只是全都朝着外面用了。把同样的本事转回来，用在自己的住处、预算和身体上，也能让你较快缓过来。

action.en: Hand back one responsibility that isn't yours, tidy your own space, and protect one restorative evening for yourself.
action.zh: 把一件本不该你扛的琐事交还回去，整理好自己的空间，为自己留出一整晚真正放松的时间。

outcome.en: Reclaiming your own replenishment restores both ease and healthier boundaries with the people you love.
outcome.zh: 把重心收回来滋养自己后，从容感会回来，你与身边人的边界也会更舒展健康。

advice.en: You cannot nurture anyone well from an empty larder—restock your own reserves first.
advice.zh: 粮仓见底时谁也滋养不好——先把你自己的精力与安全感补满。

hidden.en: Check for resentment you have not voiced about how little care comes back to you, and ask whether helping has become a way of keeping control or feeling needed.
hidden.zh: 看看心里是否压着没说出口的委屈——回到你身上的照顾那么少；也问问自己，“帮忙”是否已变成一种掌控，或确认自己被需要的方式。

self.en: You are the over-stretched caretaker in this—doing for others what they could do themselves, anxious about money or comfort, and running on very little yourself.
self.zh: 你是这件事里操劳过度的照料者——别人本可以自己做的事也替着做了，为钱或安稳而焦虑，自己却快要撑不住了。

other.en: The other person appears either worn out from looking after everyone or overly involved in managing your affairs; what is offered as help may come with a good deal of hovering.
other.zh: 对方看起来要么因照顾所有人而筋疲力尽，要么对你的事插手过多；以帮忙名义给出的东西，可能附带着不少寸步不离的盯管。

external.en: The demands of home, work, and dependants are heavy and uneven right now, and the practical support that would normally share the load is thin or missing.
external.zh: 眼下家里、工作和需要你照顾的人带来的负担又重又不均，本该有人分担的实际支持，却很单薄或根本缺席。

hopes_fears.en: You hope someone will finally take care of you for a change, yet fear that if you stopped managing everything, things would fall apart—or you would no longer be needed.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着终于能换别人来照顾你一回，却又怕自己一旦不再事事操持，一切就会散架，或者再也没人需要你。

general.en: Restore work-life balance and stop over-functioning for others. Ground yourself before carrying more.
general.zh: 星币王后逆位提醒你及时修复生活与工作之间的失衡，停止事无巨细地替他人大包大揽。先收回外放的精力让自己落地回血。

love.en: In love, reversed Queen of Pentacles warns against mothering a partner, keeping score of chores, or letting stress crowd out tenderness.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提醒避免把伴侣当孩子管教、在琐事里暗自计较，或让现实压力挤干了温情。

career.en: At work, beware taking on invisible office housework, financial anxiety, or letting career demands swallow home life. Reset boundaries.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕默默包揽过多隐形杂务、预算与精力同时紧绷，或让工作彻底吞噬私人生活与休息边界，及时重画职责线。

health.en: Stress-related fatigue and skipped self-care are waving a flag; return to simple, warm nourishment and real sleep.
health.zh: 长期操劳带来的深层疲惫与习惯性疏于照顾自己已经亮起黄灯；立刻回归温热简单的日常饮食、舒缓节奏与踏实充足的睡眠。

spirituality.en: Release the guilt around receiving; letting yourself be supported is part of earth wisdom too.
spirituality.zh: 试着放下接受他人照料与善意时的莫名愧疚感；允许自己同样被安稳托举与滋养，这本就是完整大地智慧不可或缺的一半。

promptSpec.suitAccent: verdant emerald-verdigris, warm parchment ochre, embossed antique gold pentacle coins, sunlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: Seated serenely upon a carved limestone throne adorned with Art Nouveau fruit and foliage motifs beneath a blooming crimson-and-ivory rose archway, a warm, poised Belle Epoque Queen in a flowing deep emerald-verdigris velvet and sunlit-ivory silk gown gazes tenderly down at EXACTLY ONE gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coin cradled gently in both hands on her lap. Lush garden blooms surround her throne, and ONE alert ivory-brown hare perches quietly beside her gown hem in the foreground. Warm golden-ivory light illuminates the Queen's compassionate face, cradling hands, and the single golden pentacle against a rich midnight-indigo twilight garden.

requiredObjects.object: seated Queen on carved stone throne
embossed golden pentacle coin cradled in both hands
small hare beside throne hem

promptSpec.compositionNote: Warm, nurturing central enthroned silhouette beneath a rose arch, eyes and hands converging on EXACTLY ONE bright gold pentacle in her lap—reads effortlessly at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Sovereign mastery of the material world—turning vision into enduring wealth, order, and dependable protection.
archetypeEssence.zh: 驾驭现实世界的沉稳王者——将远见化为经久不衰的财富、秩序与可靠庇护。

en: Commanding King seated on a heavy stone throne carved with bull heads
Single golden pentacle held upright and steady in his left hand
Short golden scepter of earthly authority held in his right hand
Grapevine-embroidered robes and flourishing castle garden surrounding the throne
zh: 稳坐于雕刻公牛头石座之上的沉稳国王
左手稳稳托立于膝侧的一枚古金星币
右手执握象征现实权柄的短金权杖
绣满葡萄藤纹的华贵长袍与环绕王座的繁茂城堡花园

en: Commanding Belle Epoque sovereign in rich emerald-verdigris and molten-gold grapevine-embroidered robes seated on a bull-carved stone throne
Exactly one gleaming embossed antique-gold pentacle coin held upright with quiet authority in his left hand
Ornate short antique-gold scepter resting firmly in his right hand, with armored boot visible beneath the robe
Flourishing castle garden archway and warm parchment-gold illumination contrasting against deep midnight-indigo sky
zh: 身着祖母绿与熔金葡萄藤刺绣华袍、稳坐于公牛石雕王座上的威严美好年代国王
左手沉稳托立于膝前的恰好一枚浮雕古金星币
右手紧握古金短权杖，袍角下隐现坚固战靴
繁茂城堡花园与暖羊皮纸金光辉，在深邃午夜蓝天幕下尽显鼎盛气象

core.en: King of Pentacles embodies seasoned prosperity: sound judgment, financial acumen, and the calm authority to build institutions that stay solvent, generous, and rock-solid.
core.zh: 星币国王体现历经锤炼的鼎盛格局：老练的判断力、稳健的财商，以及把事业与家业经营得既富足又厚重可靠的沉静权威。

message.en: Think like a long-term owner—verify the fundamentals, steward resources wisely, and lead with steady, unhurried authority.
message.zh: 以长期掌舵者的格局去思考——看透基本面、稳健配置资源，用不疾不徐的笃定去引领全局。

foundation.en: Proven leadership, sound capital management, or a seasoned mentor created the durable structure you stand on.
foundation.zh: 久经考验的统筹力、稳健资本运作或老练前辈的加持，搭起了今天牢靠的盘子。

present.en: You have real command over the practical levers here—use patience, leverage, and disciplined execution to lock in lasting gains.
present.zh: 你已握住局面里最关键的现实杠杆——用耐心、资源整合与稳健执行把长期收益落袋为安。

challenge.en: Beware of becoming overly conservative, or of measuring every human choice solely by its return on investment.
challenge.zh: 当心变得过于保守，也别把每一个关乎人的选择都只按回报率来衡量。

resource.en: Executive judgment, strong credit, reliable networks, and calm risk management are working in your favor.
resource.zh: 成熟的决策眼光、良好信用、可靠人脉与沉稳风控，正全面为你加分。

action.en: Take full ownership of the budget and strategy, close the deal on fair solid terms, and back your team with real resources.
action.zh: 全面接手预算与战略拍板，按公允扎实的条款落定合作，并用实打实的资源托住团队。

outcome.en: If this stewardship continues, enduring financial strength, respected authority, and a thriving enterprise are likely to settle firmly into place.
outcome.zh: 若这样稳健经营下去，长久的财务实力、令人信服的威望与兴旺的事业，很可能稳稳立住。

advice.en: Lead by building things that last; true power needs no loud display.
advice.zh: 靠做出经得起时间检验的基业去服众；真正的底气从不需要大声张扬。

hidden.en: Look at who actually holds the practical power here—the money, the ownership, the final say—and check whether that influence is being exercised quietly behind the scenes.
hidden.zh: 看看这里真正握着实权的是谁——钱、所有权、最后拍板的权力——再留意这份影响力是否正在幕后不动声色地起作用。

self.en: You show up as the steady provider—confident in your judgment, comfortable with responsibility, and used to being the one others rely on to make things secure.
self.zh: 你是那个稳稳撑着局面的人——对自己的判断有信心，担得起责任，也习惯了别人靠你来把事情安顿妥当。

other.en: You seem to be dealing with someone established, successful, and in control of real resources; they are likely to be generous and dependable while expecting sound, businesslike dealings.
other.zh: 你面对的似乎是一位根基深厚、事业有成、手里掌握着实在资源的人；多半慷慨而可靠，同时也期待往来稳妥、公事公办。

external.en: The conditions are solid and well-backed: strong finances, experienced leadership, or an established organization stands behind this, favoring proven methods over experiments.
external.zh: 外部条件扎实且有靠山：雄厚的财力、经验老到的领导，或一个成熟的组织在背后支撑，也更看重经过验证的做法，而不是试验。

hopes_fears.en: Your hope is to be secure, respected, and able to provide for everyone who depends on you; your fear is being valued only for what you can supply.
hopes_fears.zh: 你的盼望是有一天足够安稳、受人敬重，也供得起每一个依靠你的人；你的担心是别人看重的，只是你能提供的东西。

general.en: Mastery, stability, and practical leadership anchor this reading. Execute with calm confidence and long-term stewardship.
general.zh: 炉火纯青的实操能力、稳固可信赖的格局与务实领导力是此刻核心。带着沉静笃定的定力与长远眼光稳步落子并守成增效。

love.en: In love, King of Pentacles offers steadfast protection, loyalty, and a partner who backs words with real-world stability and generosity.
love.zh: 在感情中，星币国王代表厚重可靠的守护与担当——不空谈浪漫，而是用稳稳的现实托底与大方体贴护你周全。

career.en: At work, this is peak business acumen: executive leadership, profitable scaling, sound investing, and building a reputation people trust with real stakes.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，这是顶级的商业与管理格局：稳健扩张、精准配置资本，建立起让人放心托付重任的信誉。

health.en: For wellbeing, strong constitution and disciplined lifestyle stewardship keep your energy steady over the long haul.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，良好的底子配合有章法的长期养护，能让你的精力在漫长赛程中始终稳健。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, mastery of matter serves a higher generosity—using wealth and power as instruments of shelter rather than ego.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，驾驭物质的最高境界是厚德载物——把财富与权柄化作庇护众人的器皿，而非满足私欲的标签。

core.en: King of Pentacles reversed warns of stubborn materialism, controlling leadership, or poor stewardship—either clutching wealth out of greed or gambling recklessly with hard-won stability.
core.zh: 星币国王逆位警示僵化的物质执念、专断控制或经营失策——要么因贪恋权财而冷硬狭隘，要么在稳固家业上贸然冒进。

blocked.en: Stubborn resistance to necessary change or poor financial discipline undermining authority.
blocked.zh: 固执抗拒必要转型，或财务纪律松弛，正在削弱你的掌控力。

excess.en: Greed, status obsession, or using money as leverage to control people around you.
excess.zh: 过度逐利、沉迷排场，或把金钱与资源当成拿捏他人的筹码。

internalized.en: Tying your entire self-worth to net worth and fearing collapse if numbers dip.
internalized.zh: 把全部自我价值都绑死在账面数字上，一有波动就暗自恐慌。

release.en: Stepping down from rigid control and redefining success beyond sheer accumulation.
release.zh: 卸下紧绷的掌控欲，把“成功”的定义从单纯囤积拓宽到真正有滋味的丰盛。

message.en: Check what your success is serving. Wealth and authority are meant to make life steadier and more generous—not to control people or to prop up your sense of worth.
message.zh: 看看你的成功究竟在为什么服务。财富与权威本该让生活更稳、让人更大方，而不是用来控制别人，或支撑自己的价值感。

foundation.en: A pattern of putting money or control ahead of everything else—or a costly lapse in financial judgment—lies behind this and has already strained trust.
foundation.zh: 一种把钱或掌控摆在一切之上的习惯，或一次代价不小的财务误判，是这件事的背景，也已经让信任吃了紧。

present.en: Stewardship has slipped: decisions are being driven by ego, fear, or appetite for more, and the stability that took years to build is being gripped too hard or risked too freely.
present.zh: 对家底的经营出了偏差：做决定的是面子、恐惧或贪多的胃口，花多年才建起的安稳，不是被攥得太死，就是被赌得太随意。

challenge.en: Rigidity, greed, or short-sighted financial risk is threatening a solid foundation.
challenge.zh: 僵化专断、贪多求快或短视的财务冒险，正在动摇原本稳固的根基。

resource.en: The experience and practical know-how are still yours, and so is the option of loosening control. A definition of success wider than the balance sheet is available whenever you choose it.
resource.zh: 经验与实干的本领仍在你手里，放松掌控这个选项也在。一种比账面数字更宽的“成功”定义，随时等你去选。

action.en: Audit the books honestly, cut one ego-driven expense or risky bet, and listen to dissenting practical advice.
action.zh: 诚实核查账本，砍掉一笔虚荣开销或激进赌注，认真听进一句刺耳却务实的忠告。

outcome.en: Restoring humility and sound governance protects what you built before cracks widen.
outcome.zh: 重新找回谦逊与稳健治理，能在裂缝扩大前稳稳护住你辛苦打下的基业。

advice.en: Rule your resources rather than letting the fear of losing them rule you.
advice.zh: 做资源的主人，别反过来被“害怕失去”牵着鼻子走。

hidden.en: Ask how much of your self-worth is riding on the numbers, and whether money or favors are being used as leverage in ways nobody is naming.
hidden.zh: 问问自己，有多少自我价值押在了那些数字上；也看看钱或恩惠是否正被当成筹码使用，却没人点破。

self.en: You are coming across as controlling or unyielding—measuring yourself and others by money and status, resisting advice, and privately anxious about any sign of decline.
self.zh: 你现在显得控制欲强或不肯让步——用钱和地位衡量自己与他人，听不进劝，私下又为任何一点下滑的迹象而不安。

other.en: The other party appears domineering or transactional, possibly using money or position to get their way; judge them by how they handle obligations, since generosity may come with control.
other.zh: 对方看起来强势或凡事讲交换，可能会用钱或地位来达到目的；不妨先看其怎样对待应尽的义务再下判断，因为这份大方也许连着掌控。

external.en: The powers that shape this situation are rigid or self-interested: an inflexible boss, a profit-first organization, or financial conditions that have become unstable through poor management.
external.zh: 左右这个局面的力量僵硬或自利：一个不肯变通的上司，一个利润至上的组织，或因经营不善而变得不稳的财务状况。

hopes_fears.en: You hope more money or control will finally make you feel safe, yet fear that one downturn would strip away your standing—and with it, your sense of who you are.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望更多的钱或掌控终于能让自己感到安全，却又怕一次下滑就会夺走你的地位，连同你对“自己是谁”的认定。

general.en: Check where ambition has turned rigid, controlling, or overly transactional. Return to integrity and prudent fundamentals.
general.zh: 星币国王逆位提醒你审视：进取心是否已滑向僵硬、控制或过度算计？重新回到诚信与稳健基本面。

love.en: In love, reversed King of Pentacles flags emotional stubbornness, workaholism, or trying to substitute gifts for genuine presence.
love.zh: 在感情中，它提示过度固执己见、工作狂倾向压过相处质量，或试图用物质安排与金钱补偿来替代真正走心的日常情感陪伴。

career.en: At work, watch for authoritarian management, cutthroat greed, or sloppy risk controls. Tighten governance and lead with fairness.
career.zh: 在工作与财务上，警惕一言堂、短视逐利或风控松懈。收紧规范，以公允与透明重新立威。

health.en: Overindulgence or ignoring stress while chasing status takes a quiet toll; return to moderate, grounded habits.
health.zh: 频繁应酬放纵，或在持续追逐成就与安全感的过程中忽视长期慢性压力，正在悄悄透支身体底子；回到节制踏实的日常节律。

spirituality.en: Remember that possessions are tools, not identity; loosen your grip on status so wisdom can breathe.
spirituality.zh: 清醒记住财富、资产与社会头衔都只是服务生活的工具而非你的本质；松开对身份标签的紧抓，真正的智慧与自由才能呼吸。
